title: Comment on: Microscopic signatures of an imaginary charge density wave in a kagome metal
summary: In this Comment, exact diagonalization and quantitative analysis show that the reported signatures of loop currents in Ref. [arXiv:2605.05101; https://doi.org/10.1038/s41567-026-03339-8] can instead be explained by crystalline mosaicity and pre-transitional CDW fluctuations. Specifically: (i) the NQR linewidth tracks a standard Curie-Weiss (CW) law with no anomalies; (ii) the Zp-NQR asymmetric lineshapes stem from an angular mosaic spread, reproducing the spin-transition-dependent skewness; and (iii) the reported emergent field ($h_{\rm loc}$) arises from particular fitting constraints and attributing the angular distribution to an internal field rather than mosaicity. Consequently, the data in Ref. [arXiv:2605.05101; https://doi.org/10.1038/s41567-026-03339-8] remain insufficient to establish TRSB due to loop currents or a phase transition at $T^* \sim$ 120 K.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇评论性文章，通过精确对角化和定量分析，指出arXiv:2605.05101论文中报告的回路电流特征实际上可以用晶体镶嵌（mosaicity）和相变前的电荷密度波（CDW）涨落来解释，而非时间反演对称性破缺（TRSB）的证据。
AI.motivation: 原作者声称在T*~120K处观察到由回路电流引起的时间反演对称性破缺和相变，但作者认为这些结论缺乏充分证据，可能是实验方法或数据分析中的伪影所致。
AI.method: 采用精确对角化和定量分析方法，从三个角度论证：（i）NQR线宽遵循标准Curie-Weiss定律，无异常；（ii）Zp-NQR不对称线形源于角度镶嵌展宽，可重现自旋跃迁依赖的偏斜度；（iii）所谓的内场h_loc源于特定的拟合约束，是将角度分布误归因于内场而非镶嵌的结果。
AI.result: 分析表明原论文中报告的所有特征都可以由晶体镶嵌性和相变前CDW涨落解释，不存在真实的回路电流证据。
AI.conclusion: 原文数据不足以证明由回路电流引起的TRSB或T*~120K处的相变，需要更严格的实验证据来支持其结论。

title: On first-order thermodynamic equilibrium conditions for fluid-fluid and solid-phase interfaces
summary: Starting from the constrained variational formulation of Larché and Cahn for solids in contact with fluids, a unified thermodynamic framework for such systems is developed. Both bulk and interfacial equilibrium conditions arise as stationarity conditions of a single thermodynamic functional. While earlier theory neglects a full treatment of interfacial contributions and therefore cannot describe systems in which surface effects are significant, the present formulation incorporates interfacial thermodynamics directly into the variational principle. The framework is introduced first for fluid-fluid systems to establish the underlying mathematical structure, and is then extended to solid-fluid interfaces. Within this setting, classical equilibrium relations for heterogeneous systems emerge naturally from different classes of admissible variations, providing a common theoretical basis for bulk, interfacial, and configurational thermodynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Larché和Cahn的约束变分公式，为固体与流体接触系统建立了统一的热力学框架，将界面热力学直接纳入变分原理，使体相与界面平衡条件均作为单一热力学泛函的驻点条件自然涌现。
AI.motivation: 早期理论未完整处理界面贡献，因此无法描述表面效应显著的系统。需要一个将界面热力学直接纳入变分原理的统一框架，以涵盖体相、界面和构型热力学。
AI.method: 从Larché-Cahn的约束变分公式出发，构建统一热力学框架。先在流体-流体系统中建立基本数学结构，再推广到固体-流体界面。通过不同类别的容许变分，使经典非均匀系统平衡关系自然涌现。
AI.result: 体相和界面平衡条件均可作为单一热力学泛函的驻点条件获得；经典的异质系统平衡关系从不同类别的容许变分中自然导出，为体相、界面和构型热力学提供了共同的理论基础。
AI.conclusion: 该框架弥补了早期理论对界面贡献处理的缺失，为表面效应显著的系统提供了统一的热力学描述基础。

title: Far-from-equilibrium topological phase transition in one dimension
summary: We uncover a mechanism for far-from-equilibrium topological phase transitions, via a one-dimensional compact phase model evolving deterministically from random initial conditions. It rests on topology and symmetry rather than on phenomenological postulates: phase compactness permits vortices, and a homogeneous fixed point suppresses their nucleation, with the fixed point itself implied by phase-shift symmetry. The competition between vortex-induced disordering and relaxation toward homogeneity drives a continuous nonequilibrium transition, whose universality class we identify as directed percolation (DP). We demonstrate this by constructing the corresponding effective field theory and numerically confirming DP critical scaling through dynamical-scaling analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了一种远非平衡拓扑相变机制，通过一维紧致相位模型从随机初始条件确定性演化实现。该机制基于拓扑与对称性而非唯象假设：相位紧致性允许涡旋存在，均匀不动点抑制涡旋成核，而该不动点由相移对称性所蕴含。涡旋引起的无序化与向均匀性弛豫之间的竞争驱动连续非平衡相变，其普适类被确定为有向渗流（DP），并通过有效场论构建与动力学标度数值分析加以证实。
AI.motivation: 探索远非平衡系统中拓扑相变的通用机制，超越现有唯象模型，寻找基于基本对称性和拓扑约束的非平衡相变统一框架。
AI.method: 构建一维紧致相位模型，利用相位紧致性引入涡旋缺陷，通过相移对称性确保均匀不动点存在；构建对应有效场论，并进行动力学标度数值模拟以验证普适类归属。
AI.result: 成功识别出该非平衡拓扑相变的普适类为有向渗流（DP），并通过理论构建与数值模拟双重验证了DP临界标度行为。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了基于拓扑与对称性原理即可得到非平衡相变的普适类（DP），为理解非平衡拓扑相变提供了一个不依赖唯象假设的机制性框架。

title: Far-from-equilibrium scaling of non-abelian Goldstone modes
summary: We identify a broad class of nonthermal phases generated by the interplay of continuous symmetry breaking and weak nonequilibrium driving. Extending Kardar-Parisi-Zhang (KPZ) physics beyond the single $SO(2)$ chronon associated with periodically broken time translations, we construct nonequilibrium nonlinear sigma models for $SO(2)\times O(N)$ symmetry, describing non-Abelian time crystals with coexisting temporal and internal order. This symmetry structure arises naturally in driven quantum materials, active matter, and optically induced periodic states. For rotating and oscillating phases, we derive the Goldstone theories and show that chronon-$O(N)$ couplings remain finite deep in the ordered regime. One-loop renormalization group analysis reveals a KPZ-like dimensional structure: in $d=1,2$, arbitrarily weak nonequilibrium perturbations destabilize the equilibrium fixed point and generate strongly coupled nonthermal fixed points, realizing emergent equilibrium breaking. By contrast, for $d > 2$, weak perturbations are irrelevant and effective equilibrium is restored. A central result is unconventional weak dynamic scaling in the rotating phase: strongly coupled Goldstone sectors acquire distinct universal dynamical exponents despite belonging to the same order parameter. We characterize this scaling analytically and corroborate it through direct simulations in $1+1$ dimensions. In the oscillating phase, we recover and extend weak-scaling regimes known from drifting polymers. Finally, compactness and topological defects ultimately destroy long-range order but leave experimentally accessible nonthermal scaling windows. Together, these results extend KPZ universality to non-Abelian symmetry breaking.

AI.tldr: 本文识别了一类由连续对称性破缺与弱非平衡驱动相互作用产生的非热相，将Kardar-Parisi-Zhang（KPZ）物理从单一SO(2)时间晶体扩展到SO(2)×O(N)非阿贝尔时间晶体，建立了同时具有时间序和内部序的非平衡非线性sigma模型，并通过单圈重整化群分析和直接数值模拟揭示了维度相关的动力学普适性行为。
AI.motivation: 现有KPZ物理和非平衡相变研究主要局限于单一SO(2)对称性（即周期破缺的时间平移），尚未系统处理同时具有时间序与非阿贝尔内部序（O(N)对称）的复杂动力学系统。理解这类非阿贝尔时间晶体的非平衡普适性行为，对于驱动量子材料、活性物质和光诱导周期态等实际系统具有重要意义。
AI.method: 论文构建了SO(2)×O(N)对称的非平衡非线性sigma模型，分别针对旋转相和振荡相推导Goldstone理论；采用单圈重整化群分析揭示KPZ类维度结构；并通过1+1维直接数值模拟验证分析结果，同时考虑紧致性和拓扑缺陷的影响。
AI.result: 在d=1,2维中，任意弱的非平衡扰动都会使平衡不动点失稳并产生强耦合非热不动点，实现涌现平衡破缺；在d>2维中，弱扰动无关，有效平衡得以恢复。核心发现是旋转相中强耦合Goldstone扇区具有非传统的弱动力学标度——同一序参量的不同扇区获得不同的普适动力学指数，该结果通过1+1维模拟得到证实。振荡相中恢复并扩展了漂移聚合物的弱标度区域，而拓扑缺陷最终摧毁长程有序但留下实验可及的非热标度窗口。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将KPZ普适性扩展到非阿贝尔对称性破缺系统，建立了非阿贝尔时间晶体中弱非平衡驱动的完整理论框架，揭示了维度相关的临界行为（d≤2失稳、d>2恢复平衡）以及旋转相中同一序参量内不同指数共存的新奇弱动力学标度现象。

title: Thickness-dependent secondary-electron emission from suspended MoS$_2$ membranes in the helium ion microscope
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to Applied Physics Letters. Supplementary material included as an ancillary file
summary: Secondary-electron (SE) emission in the helium ion microscope (HIM) becomes sensitive to membrane thickness when the sample is thin enough for He-ion transmission and when the SEs emitted from the bottom surface are collected. We correlated the total SE intensity of suspended, nanometer-thick MoS$_2$ flakes on lacey carbon with thickness measured independently by electron energy-loss spectroscopy. The response peaks at 40-55 nm, with an apparent back-to-front SE signal ratio reaching 4.7. The peaked, thickness-dependent component is attributed primarily to SE emission at the bottom surface of the flake, rather than to transmitted ions striking instrument surfaces. Applying SRIM ionization profiles, an asymmetric SE-escape model with a longer escape depth on the exit side reproduces the response. We find an effective exit-side escape depth of approximately 10 nm, five times the assumed 2 nm entrance value, suggesting that deposited energy reaches the exit surface far more efficiently than the entrance surface or that the SRIM model's energy deposition profile is shifted by an effect such as channeling. The correlation provides a rapid thickness screen for suspended membranes and a route to testing low-energy ion-solid interaction models in thin materials.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了氦离子显微镜中悬浮超薄MoS₂薄膜的二次电子发射对膜厚度的依赖性。总二次电子强度在40-55 nm厚度处出现峰值，背面/正面信号比可达4.7，该峰状响应主要归因于薄膜底面（出射侧）的二次电子发射，而非透射离子撞击仪器表面所致。
AI.motivation: 理解氦离子显微镜中二次电子发射随样品厚度的变化规律，建立快速厚度筛查方法，并为低能离子-固体相互作用模型提供实验验证途径。
AI.method: 将悬浮在lacey碳上的纳米级MoS₂薄片的总二次电子强度与通过电子能量损失谱独立测量的厚度相关联。使用SRIM电离分布剖面，构建非对称二次电子逃逸模型（出射侧逃逸深度大于入射侧）来拟合实验响应。
AI.result: 响应在40-55 nm处出现峰值。发现有效出射侧逃逸深度约为10 nm，是假设的入射侧2 nm逃逸深度的5倍，表明沉积能量到达出射表面的效率远高于入射表面，或SRIM模型的能量沉积分布在诸如沟道效应等机制下发生偏移。
AI.conclusion: 二次电子强度与厚度的相关性为悬浮膜提供了一种快速厚度筛查手段，并为在薄膜材料中测试低能离子-固体相互作用模型开辟了新途径。

title: Complete Suppression of Thermomagnetic Instabilities in Nb Superconducting Films by Combined Metallic Layers and Ion Irradiation
summary: Thermomagnetic instabilities in superconducting films can trigger flux avalanches that disrupt the critical state and impair the performance of superconducting devices. Here we investigate the stabilization of Nb thin films subjected to a perpendicular magnetic field by two complementary approaches: the addition of normal-metal overlayers and Ar ion irradiation. Magnetization measurements and magneto-optical imaging show that the metallic layers suppress the onset of avalanches at low applied fields, whereas ion irradiation reduces the high-field portion of the instability region by shifting the upper threshold for avalanche activity to lower fields. When combined in the same sample, these two partial stabilization effects lead to complete suppression of thermomagnetic instabilities. In particular, a Nb film coated with a 1~\(μ\)m-thick Cu layer after irradiation at a fluence of \(5\times10^{16}\)~ions/cm\(^2\) exhibits smooth magnetization curves and avalanche-free flux penetration. This combined treatment restores stable critical-state behavior and provides a practical route for stabilizing Nb superconducting films in thin-film superconducting technologies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了两种互补方法（添加正常金属覆盖层和Ar离子辐照）稳定Nb超导薄膜的热磁不稳定性。金属层抑制低场下的雪崩，离子辐照将高场不稳定区域上阈值移至更低场。两者结合可完全抑制热磁不稳定性，其中1μm厚Cu覆盖层结合5×10^16 ions/cm²辐照的Nb薄膜展现出光滑磁化曲线和无雪崩的磁通穿透。
AI.motivation: 热磁不稳定性会引发磁通雪崩，破坏超导薄膜的临界态并损害超导器件性能，因此需要寻找有效的稳定化方法。
AI.method: 采用两种互补策略：添加正常金属覆盖层和Ar离子辐照，并通过磁化测量和磁光成像表征其效果，同时将两种方法结合在同一薄膜样品上评估协同效应。
AI.result: 金属覆盖层抑制低场雪崩起始；离子辐照降低高场不稳定区域上阈值；两者结合的样品实现了热磁不稳定性的完全抑制，1μm Cu覆盖层加辐照的薄膜表现出光滑磁化曲线和无雪崩磁通穿透。
AI.conclusion: 组合处理恢复了稳定的临界态行为，为薄膜超导技术中稳定Nb超导薄膜提供了切实可行的途径。

title: Strong photoresponse of edge two-dimensional electrons in a magnetic field
summary: Electrons in two-dimensional electron gases in the presence of an out-of-plane magnetic field propagate along the edge with a high velocity of the order of the Fermi velocity. Under microwave and terahertz radiation, photon absorption by these electrons provides a pathway to realising sensitive radiation detection. Here, we develop a detailed quantum theory of the photocurrent generated in such a system by an incident electromagnetic wave and propose an experimental geometry for observing the predicted phenomenon. By using suitably arranged radiation confinement structures, a strong photocurrent generation efficiency can be obtained. We also demonstrate that the resulting photoresponse in III-V semiconductor structures can be orders of magnitude higher than that measured in graphene.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了一个详细的量子理论，描述二维电子气在垂直磁场中边缘态电子在微波和太赫兹辐射下的光电离电流产生机制，并提出一种实验几何结构来观测该现象，证明在III-V半导体结构中可获得比石墨烯高数个数量级的光响应。
AI.motivation: 二维电子气在垂直磁场下边缘态电子以费米速度传播，其在微波和太赫兹辐射下吸收光子为灵敏辐射探测提供了可能性，但缺乏详细的量子理论描述和有效的实验观测方案。
AI.method: 发展入射电磁波在二维电子气中产生光电流的详细量子理论，并利用适当布置的辐射限制结构增强光电流产生效率，提出相应的实验几何方案。
AI.result: 通过辐射限制结构可获得强光电流产生效率；在III-V半导体结构中的光响应比石墨烯中测量到的结果高数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 该量子理论和实验几何方案为利用二维电子气边缘态实现高灵敏微波/太赫兹探测提供了可行途径，且III-V半导体结构在性能上显著优于石墨烯。

title: Learning Spin Hamiltonians from Terahertz Two-Dimensional Coherent Spectroscopy
summary: Effective Hamiltonians connect microscopic interactions to measurable collective behavior in quantum materials, but determining their parameters directly from experiment remains a challenging inverse problem. We introduce a supervised machine-learning framework that infers Hamiltonian parameters from nonlinear terahertz two-dimensional coherent spectra. A calibrated forward model generates spectra from candidate Hamiltonians, a common preprocessing pipeline maps simulated and experimental spectra into the same representation, and a neural network learns the inverse map from spectral fingerprints to microscopic parameters. We demonstrate the approach for rare-earth orthoferrites using a two-sublattice Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert spin model with exchange, Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interaction, anisotropies, and damping. Synthetic benchmarks show that nonlinear spectra encode parameters beyond those fixed by the linear response, with inference accuracy tracking the physical spectral sensitivity and robustness against noise improved by using multiple inter-pulse delays. Applied to experimental THz-2DCS data from Sm$_{0.4}$Er$_{0.6}$FeO$_3$, the inferred parameters yield physically reasonable forward simulations, while remaining discrepancies identify limitations of the reduced model. These results establish THz-2DCS as a data-rich platform for effective-Hamiltonian inference and model refinement, enabling experimentally driven identification of microscopic interactions while providing a foundation for understanding, predicting, and ultimately controlling the emergent properties of quantum materials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种监督式机器学习框架，从非线性太赫兹二维相干光谱中推断量子材料的有效哈密顿量参数，并在稀土正铁氧体上进行了实验验证。
AI.motivation: 有效哈密顿量连接微观相互作用与宏观集体行为，但直接从实验数据确定哈密顿量参数是一个具有挑战性的逆问题，传统方法难以从复杂的光谱指纹中提取微观参数。
AI.method: 采用三层框架：(1) 标定的前向模型从候选哈密顿量生成光谱；(2) 统一的预处理流程将模拟和实验光谱映射到同一表征空间；(3) 神经网络学习从光谱指纹到微观参数的逆映射。模型采用双子格Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert自旋模型，包含交换、Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用、各向异性和阻尼。
AI.result: 合成基准测试表明非线性光谱编码了超越线性响应固定的参数信息，推断精度与物理光谱敏感性一致，多脉冲延迟可提高抗噪鲁棒性。应用于Sm0.4Er0.6FeO3的实验THz-2DCS数据，推断参数产生物理合理的前向模拟，残留差异暴露了简化模型的局限性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了THz-2DCS作为有效哈密顿量推断和模型精化的数据丰富平台，实现实验驱动的微观相互作用识别，为理解、预测和最终控制量子材料的涌现性质奠定基础。

title: Collective Excitonic Entanglement in Singlet Fission
summary: Singlet fission, the conversion of one singlet exciton into two triplet excitons, has the potential to revolutionize solar energy production by boosting the efficiency of solar cells beyond the Shockley-Queisser limit. However, the practical realization of singlet fission remains an outstanding challenge, and its underlying mechanisms have long been debated. Here we show that singlet fission arises from a distinctive type of collective excitonic entanglement in which the excitons condense into a single particle-hole mode, the same principle that leads to the Bose-Einstein condensation of excitons. Quantitatively, this condensation appears as a large eigenvalue of the particle-hole reduced density matrix (RDM), representing multiple excitons occupying a collective mode. We utilize the particle-hole RDM to capture the intrinsic particle-hole correlations in singlet fission materials including acene crystals and covalently linked pentacene dimers, revealing how structural changes control singlet fission mechanisms and modulate the contributions of charge transfer states. The same characteristic enhancement of excitonic population in a single mode is common to the onset of exciton condensation and the mechanism of photosynthetic energy transfer. Together, our results establish a unifying framework for understanding the origins of singlet fission in terms of collective excitonic entanglement.

AI.tldr: 本文表明单线态裂变源于一种独特的集体激子纠缠，其中激子凝聚到单一的粒子-空穴模式中，这与激子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚的原理相同。通过粒子-空穴约化密度矩阵（RDM）的大特征值来量化这种凝聚，并在并五苯二聚体和并苯晶体中揭示了结构变化如何调控单线态裂变机制。
AI.motivation: 单线态裂变有望将太阳能电池效率提升到Shockley-Queisser极限之外，但其实际实现仍是突出挑战，且其潜在机制长期存在争议，需要新的理论框架来统一理解。
AI.method: 提出粒子-空穴约化密度矩阵（RDM）方法，通过其大特征值量化激子在单一集体模式中的凝聚，并将此框架应用于并苯晶体和共价连接的并五苯二聚体，分析结构变化对单线态裂变机制和电荷转移态贡献的影响。
AI.result: 揭示了单线态裂变源于集体激子纠缠，即激子凝聚到单一粒子-空穴模式中；该特征增强与激子凝聚的起始和光合能量转移机制具有共通性，并在实际材料中验证了该框架。
AI.conclusion: 建立了以集体激子纠缠为核心的单线态裂变统一理解框架，将单线态裂变、激子凝聚和光合能量转移联系起来，为理解激子现象起源提供了统一的视角。

title: Stochastic twinning in confined volumes of Mg: Insights from in-situ micromechanical testing and atomistic simulations
summary: Tensile twinning plays a central role in accommodating <c>-axis plasticity in Mg. In bulk Mg, twinning typically shows a relatively deterministic response with a low critical stress, whereas in confined volumes it exhibits pronounced scatter, complicating the prediction of small-scale mechanical behavior. In this study, we investigate the origin of this stochasticity by combining site-specific micropillar compression with atomistic simulations. Experiments show that under <a>-axis compression, plastic deformation is dominated by {10-12} twinning, with each discrete stress drop in the stress-strain response marking the activation and rapid advance of a twin. Atomistic simulations further separate twinning into two mechanistic regimes: nucleation and longitudinal propagation occur in a high-stress, shuffle-assisted regime, whereas lateral thickening proceeds in a low-stress regime controlled by disconnection glide. Linking these mechanistic insights with post-mortem characterization of deformed pillars demonstrates that the scatter in measured yield stresses arises from stochastic selection among competing twinning pathways, governed by the local defect landscape (presence, distribution, and morphology of pre-existing defects). Overall, this work identifies an atomistic basis for size-dependent stochastic twinning in Mg and provides a general framework for materials whose plasticity is controlled by discrete activation events.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过结合位点特异性微柱压缩实验和原子模拟，揭示了镁中拉伸孪晶在受限体积下表现出随机性的根本原因：孪晶的形核与纵向传播发生在高应力、伴随原子重排的机制中，而侧向增厚则在低应力下由位错滑移控制。实验测量的屈服应力散度源于局部缺陷环境中竞争性孪晶路径的随机选择。
AI.motivation: 镁的拉伸孪晶在承载<c>轴塑性中起关键作用，但在体材料中呈现确定性响应，而在受限体积中表现出明显的随机性，这使得小尺度力学行为的预测变得复杂。理解这种随机性的来源对于可靠预测微纳尺度镁材料的力学性能至关重要。
AI.method: 采用两种互补方法：1）位点特异性微柱压缩实验，观察<a>轴压缩下{10-12}孪晶主导的塑性变形及应力-应变曲线中的离散应力降；2）原子模拟，将孪晶过程分解为形核/纵向传播（高应力、伴随原子重排辅助）和侧向增厚（低应力、位错滑动控制）两个机制性阶段。
AI.result: 实验显示每次应力降对应一个孪晶的激活和快速推进；原子模拟揭示了孪晶形核/纵向传播与侧向增厚的不同应力机制；结合变形后表征，证明屈服应力的离散性源于预存缺陷的局部分布对竞争性孪晶路径的随机选择。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为镁的尺寸依赖性随机孪晶行为提供了原子层面的解释，并为那些塑性由离散激活事件控制的材料提供了通用分析框架。

title: Superconductivity in strongly overdoped cuprates: beyond the single-band model
summary: In order to explain the observation of an extended superconducting region in several overdoped cuprates, which contrasts the dome scenario, by means of neutron and synchrotron x-ray powder diffraction we study the crystal structure of YBa$_2$Cu$_3$O$_{y}$, where strong oxygen overdoping up to $y = 7.4$ is achieved under high-pressure. A bond valence sum analysis indicates that 1/5 of the extra holes created by the excess oxygen are transferred to the CuO$_2$ planes, thus increasing the hole density up to $p=0.27$ hole/Cu, where superconductivity is expected to vanish according to the dome scenario. Instead, our data confirm a previous observation [Okai, Ono and Mitsuhashi, Physica C: Superconductivity {\bf 366}, 164 (2002)] that the superconducting critical temperature, $T_c$, remains constant with $y$. Our data analysis accounts for this discrepancy in terms of the much shorter bond between the apical oxygen and the planar Cu ion, which suggests that the extra holes occupy the $a_1$-symmetry states formed by $d_{3z^2-r^2}$ orbitals, instead of the usual $b_1$-symmetry Zhang-Rice singlet states formed by $d_{x^2-y^2}$ orbitals. Suitable spectroscopic measurements on single crystals may support such a two-band scenario, which would require a totally different theoretical approach to explain superconductivity in cuprates.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过中子与同步辐射X射线粉末衍射研究了高氧过掺杂（y=7.4）的YBa₂Cu₃O_y晶体结构，发现超导临界温度Tc不随过掺杂而下降，与传统穹顶（dome）图像相悖。键价和（BVS）分析表明额外空穴转移至CuO₂平面，使空穴密度达p=0.27，但Tc仍保持恒定。作者将此归因于顶点氧与平面Cu之间更短的键长，暗示额外空穴占据a₁对称性（d₃z²-r²轨道）态而非通常的b₁对称性Zhang-Rice单重态，提出铜氧化物超导可能需要双能带理论框架。
AI.motivation: 传统铜氧化物超导的穹顶图像预测超导性在空穴密度超过某一临界值（约p=0.27）时会消失，但实验在多个过掺杂铜氧化物中观察到超导区域扩展，这与穹顶场景矛盾。作者希望通过晶体结构研究理解这一反常现象，并探索可能的微观机制。
AI.method: 采用中子粉末衍射和同步辐射X射线粉末衍射技术，在高压条件下实现YBa₂Cu₃O_y中强氧过掺杂（y=7.4），对晶体结构进行精确测定，并通过键价和（BVS）分析计算各原子间的键长与空穴分布。
AI.result: 1）高压下实现y=7.4的强过掺杂，BVS分析显示1/5的额外空穴转移至CuO₂平面，使空穴密度达到p=0.27；2）确认了此前Okai等人的观察——Tc随y增加保持恒定，而非像穹顶场景预期那样消失；3）发现顶点氧与平面Cu之间的键长显著缩短，表明额外空穴进入a₁对称性（d₃z²-r²轨道）态而非b₁对称性的Zhang-Rice单重态。
AI.conclusion: 过掺杂铜氧化物中超导区域扩展的现象可用双能带模型解释：额外空穴占据d₃z²-r²轨道形成的a₁对称性态，而非传统的d_x²-y²轨道Zhang-Rice单重态。这一发现挑战了单一能带（单带Hubbard模型）描述铜氧化物超导的传统框架，建议通过单晶上的光谱测量验证该双能带场景，若证实将需要全新的理论方法来理解铜氧化物超导机制。

title: Systematic extinctions in inelastic neutron scattering from molecular spin clusters
summary: Inelastic neutron scattering on a single crystal resolves how the intensity of a magnetic transition of a molecular spin cluster varies with the momentum-transfer vector $\mathbf{Q}$. The point group fixes that dependence completely when a single symmetry species mediates the transition and the local spin operators contain only one occurrence of that species. Functions for such universal $\mathbf{Q}$ dependences have been tabulated. As we show here, even when these conditions are not fulfilled, the point group still fixes, at a given geometry, momentum transfers at which the intensity vanishes for every Hamiltonian that has the symmetry of the cluster. We call such momentum transfers extinctions and derive an equation whose every zero is an extinction, built from the symmetry species of the two levels and from the positions and scattering amplitudes of the magnetic sites. The extinctions follow in closed form in two cases: when each orbit of symmetry-equivalent sites contributes a single occurrence of the mediating species, and when the site phases recur under a subgroup up to one common factor.

AI.tldr: 本文研究分子自旋簇中磁跃迁的非弹性中子散射强度随动量转移矢量Q的变化。作者发现即便在特定对称条件下不成立时，点群对称性仍能固定某些动量转移位置使强度恒为零（称为"消光"），并推导出由此构建的方程，该方程的所有零点均为消光点。在两类特殊情形下消光可得到闭式解。
AI.motivation: 此前研究已表明，当单一对称物种介导磁跃迁且局域自旋算符仅包含该物种一次出现时，点群完全决定了Q依赖关系并已表格化。但实际物理系统中这些条件往往不满足，因此需要更一般的理论框架来预测强度为零的Q位置。
AI.method: 作者从点群对称性出发，推导了一个方程，其所有零点均为消光（即无论哈密顿量如何，在给定几何构型下强度必为零的动量转移）。该方程由两个能级的对称物种、磁位点的位置和散射振幅共同构建。在两种情形下消光可获得闭式解：(1)每个对称等价位点轨道仅贡献介导物种的一次出现；(2)位点相位在子群下以单一公共因子重现。
AI.result: 论文在单晶非弹性中子散射实验中验证了消光现象的存在，并给出了消光的闭式解条件。这些消光点完全由点群对称性决定，与具体哈密顿量无关。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将对称性分析推广到比此前更一般的情形，提供了一种仅基于对称性即可预测磁跃迁强度消失的动量转移位置的方法，为分子自旋簇的中子散射实验提供了理论指导。

title: Thermal effect on the anomaly-induced electromechanical response in gapped graphene
summary: Mechanical deformation of gapped graphene can act on Dirac quasiparticles as an emergent gauge field. When this deformation field couples to the same current as the electromagnetic field, the parity anomaly produces a mixed electromechanical Chern-Simons response: a phonon electric field drives a transverse electrical current, and a phonon magnetic field binds charge. Previous zero-temperature results predict a sharp change in the response when the chemical potential crosses the band edge. We show that finite temperature replaces this sharp feature by a universal smooth crossover controlled only by the ratios of temperature, gap, and chemical potential. The response remains almost quantized in the insulating regime, is rounded over a gate window of order temperature near the band edge, and approaches the doped Berry-curvature result with a controlled Sommerfeld correction. We apply the result to two experimentally useful drives: a traveling flexural wave, which produces a transverse second-harmonic current, and a dynamic phonon mixed with a static ripple, which produces a fundamental-frequency signal. The same gate-temperature line shape controls both signals. This gives a direct way to separate the anomaly-induced current from ordinary electromechanical backgrounds and to extract the effective gap and electronic temperature in graphene devices.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了有限温度下石墨烯中机械变形引起的混合电磁-机械Chern-Simons响应的行为。零温预测响应在化学势穿过带边时发生突变，而在有限温度下这一突变被光滑的普适交叉取代，仅由温度、能隙和化学势的比值控制。响应在绝缘区几乎保持量子化，在带边附近被抹圆，并在掺杂区逼近Berry曲率结果。
AI.motivation: 先前零温结果预测响应在化学势穿越带边时发生突变，但实际实验在有限温度下进行，需要理解温度如何影响这一响应的普适行为，以便从实验中提取石墨烯器件的有效能隙和电子温度。
AI.method: 通过理论分析有限温度下带隙石墨烯的力学形变与Dirac准粒子耦合产生的混合电磁-机械Chern-Simons响应，研究其随温度、能隙和化学势的比例关系的行为，并对两种实验驱动的响应（传播弯曲波产生横向二次谐波电流、动态声子叠加静态波纹产生基频信号）进行应用分析。
AI.result: 有限温度将零温下的尖锐突变替换为普适光滑交叉，该交叉仅由温度、能隙和化学势的比值决定。响应在绝缘区几乎量子化，在带边附近在温度量级的栅窗口内被抹圆，在掺杂区以受控的Sommerfeld修正逼近Berry曲率结果。两种实验驱动都产生相同的栅-温度线形。
AI.conclusion: 这种普适的温度-栅线形提供了一种直接区分反常诱导电流与普通电磁-机械背景的方法，并能从中提取石墨烯器件的有效能隙和电子温度。

title: Linear-response time-dependent density-functional theory with local range separation: Core and valence resonances of the neon atom
summary: We investigate range-separated hybrids (RSHs) and locally range-separated hybrids (LRSHs) for linear-response time-dependent density-functional theory (TDDFT) Sternheimer calculations of the photoionization spectrum of the Ne atom. This system constitutes a stringent test for approximate exchange-correlation treatments because it exhibits both valence and core resonances with very different energy scales. Building on previous work employing a simple one-parameter local range-separation function, we assess here a more flexible two-parameter range-separation function designed to improve the high-density limit. We compare photoionization spectra and resonance parameters obtained with RSHs and LRSHs. We find that the LRSH approach with the two-parameter range-separation function provides an overall satisfactory description of the photoionization spectrum, including energies for both valence and core resonances. The lifetimes of the 2s $\rightarrow$ np valence resonances are also reasonably reproduced since their decay does not involve double excitations. In contrast, the lifetimes of the 1s $\rightarrow$ np core resonances are overestimated by orders of magnitude because their Auger decay channels involve double excitations that are absent in adiabatic, single-determinant TDDFT. Obtaining more accurate resonance widths within linear-response range-separated TDDFT would require using multideterminant schemes and/or adding a frequency-dependent response kernel.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了范围分离杂化（RSH）和局域范围分离杂化（LRSH）方法在线性响应含时密度泛函理论（TDDFT）Sternheimer计算中的应用，以氖原子的光电离光谱为测试体系。作者评估了一个更灵活的双参数范围分离函数，发现LRSH方法能较好地描述价态和核心共振能量，但核心共振寿命因涉及双激发（俄歇衰变通道）而被严重高估。
AI.motivation: Ne原子同时具有能量尺度差异很大的价态和核心共振，是对近似交换关联处理的严格测试。此前工作使用简单的单参数局域范围分离函数，本文旨在通过更灵活的双参数函数改进高密度极限下的描述，并系统比较RSH与LRSH的性能。
AI.method: 采用线性响应TDDFT Sternheimer方法，对比RSH和LRSH两类范围分离杂化方案；使用双参数范围分离函数（此前为单参数版本）以改进高密度极限；对Ne原子计算光电离光谱并提取共振参数。
AI.result: 双参数LRSH方法能整体满意地描述光电离光谱，包括价态和核心共振能量；2s→np价态共振寿命能被合理重现（因为其衰变不涉及双激发）；但1s→np核心共振寿命被高估数个数量级（因俄歇衰变涉及双激发，而绝热单行列式TDDFT中缺失）。
AI.conclusion: 要在线性响应范围分离TDDFT中获得更准确的共振宽度，需要采用多行列式方案和/或加入频率依赖的响应核。该工作明确了当前绝热单行列式TDDFT在处理涉及双激发的衰变通道时的根本局限。

title: Different Environments in Quantum Statistical Mechanics: To $β$ or not to $(k_{\mathrm{B}} T)^{-1}$
summary: We piece together textbook material to re-derive the parameter $β$ entering reduced density operators from quantum statistical mechanics. By re-deriving $β$, we show that the content of $β$ depends on the particular application of statistical mechanics. We focus on two different applications, namely, electronic-structure theory (new) and thermodynamics (standard). Specifically, we show that $β$ becomes proportional to the inverse Fermi energy, when the electronic states of a system interact with the infinitely many valence electrons in a metal. On the other hand, when the environment is a heat bath, $β$ takes the well-known form of inverse temperature. To highlight the importance of using the correct form of $β$, we explore statistical descriptions of a potassium atom adsorbed on a gold surface, where the valence electrons of gold represent the environment of potassium. By treating $β$ as the inverse Fermi energy, we are able to qualitatively reproduce the fractional charging of potassium. In contrast, if we interpret $β$ as the inverse temperature, extremely high and unphysical temperatures are required to reproduce the same qualitative picture. Thereby, we illustrate the fallacy of not separating the mathematical framework of quantum statistical mechanics from its pervasive thermodynamic application.

AI.tldr: 本文通过重新推导量子统计力学中约化密度算符的参数β，证明β的内容取决于统计力学的具体应用场景：在电子结构理论中β与逆费米能成正比，而在热力学中β为逆温度。以金表面吸附钾原子为例，将β视为逆费米能可定性重现钾的部分充电现象，而将其误解为逆温度则需要极高且非物理的温度，从而揭示将量子统计力学的数学框架与其热力学应用混为一谈的谬误。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在纠正量子统计力学中参数β长期被默认为逆温度（即热力学应用）的普遍做法，指出在电子结构理论等非热力学场景中，β应具有不同的物理内涵（逆费米能），并说明错误理解β会导致非物理的结果。
AI.method: 作者从教科书材料出发重新推导约化密度算符中的参数β，分别对应电子结构理论（环境为金属中无穷多价电子）和热力学（环境为热浴）两种应用场景，推导出β分别正比于逆费米能和逆温度。随后以金表面吸附钾原子为案例，对比两种β诠释下的统计描述结果。
AI.result: 将β视为逆费米能时，可定性重现钾原子在金表面的部分充电现象；而将β误解为逆温度时，需要极高且非物理的温度才能得到相同的定性结果。
AI.conclusion: 量子统计力学的数学框架与其热力学应用不应混为一谈，β的物理含义必须根据具体应用场景来确定，否则会导致错误的物理结论。

title: Multiscale Correlation of Morphological, Chemical, and Optical Properties in p-Type Porous Silicon
summary: We report a systematic study of the correlations among electrochemical processing conditions and the morphological, chemical, and optical properties of porous silicon (pSi). Twenty pSi samples were fabricated from boron-doped (100) crystalline silicon by varying current density, etching time, and hydrofluoric-acid concentration. Scanning electron microscopy, Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy, and photoluminescence were used to characterize the resulting structures. The two-dimensional porosity varied only moderately, whereas porous-layer thickness increased with etching time and current density. The silicon oxide to silicon hydride ratio showed comparatively small variations. Corrected photoluminescence spectra were fitted with a four-component quantum-wire/quantum-dot model including localized surface-state transitions. The extracted quantum-wire and quantum-dot dimensions decreased systematically with increasing current density, while the photoluminescence maximum under 375 nm excitation showed no clear monotonic dependence on processing conditions. The results demonstrate that no single descriptor adequately captures the multiscale behavior of porous silicon.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了电化学加工条件（电流密度、蚀刻时间、氢氟酸浓度）与多孔硅形态、化学和光学性质之间的关联。通过制备20个pSi样品并进行SEM、FTIR和PL表征，发现孔隙率变化适中，层厚度随时间和电流密度增加，量子线/量子点尺寸随电流密度增加而减小，但光致发光峰值无单调依赖关系，表明单一描述符无法全面捕捉pSi的多尺度行为。
AI.motivation: 多孔硅在传感、光电子等领域有广泛应用，其性质高度依赖于电化学加工条件。然而，目前对加工参数与材料多尺度性质之间系统关联的理解尚不充分，需要全面研究以建立加工-性质关系。
AI.method: 制备20个pSi样品（硼掺杂(100)晶硅），系统变化电流密度、蚀刻时间和HF浓度；使用SEM、FTIR和PL进行表征；对校正后的PL光谱采用包含局域表面态跃迁的四分量量子线/量子点模型进行拟合。
AI.result: 二维孔隙率变化适中；多孔层厚度随蚀刻时间和电流密度增加；氧化硅/氢化硅比率变化较小；量子线和量子点尺寸随电流密度增加而系统性减小；375 nm激发下的PL峰值对加工条件无明显的单调依赖。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，没有任何单一描述符能够充分捕捉多孔硅的多尺度行为，其性质是多参数耦合作用的综合结果。

title: Simplified Silicon Nitride Nanomembrane Circuits for van der Waals Integration
summary: Two-dimensional (2D) materials and van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures provide an exceptional platform for engineering quantum devices, yet realizing their potential requires electrical integration without compromising the pristine properties of atomically thin crystals through conventional nanofabrication. Transferable circuitry addresses this challenge by decoupling circuit fabrication from device assembly, enabling electrical contacting without directly processing the active material. Here, we introduce SiN$_x$ nanomembrane (NMB) circuits realized through a simplified top-down strategy that reduces fabrication complexity, processing steps and specialized tools required by our previous bottom-up approach. As a stringent benchmark of material preservation, we electrically integrate a four-unit-cell-thick, optimally doped Bi$_2$Sr$_{2-x}$La$_x$CuO$_{6+δ}$ (Bi2201) flake and observe a superconducting transition at T$_c^{inf}$~32K, close to the T$_c^{onset}$~34K measured by susceptibility in the parent crystals. The preservation of superconductivity demonstrates electrical integration of fragile layered materials without direct exposure to conventional cleanroom procedures, providing a versatile platform for integrating increasingly complicated vdW heterostructures, moiré materials, and hybrid quantum architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种简化的SiNx纳米膜（NMB）可转移电路制备策略，用于电学集成二维材料和范德华异质结构。通过将超薄Bi2201高温超导薄片集成到该电路中，观察到了接近母体晶体本征值的超导转变温度（Tc~32K），证明了该方案能在不直接暴露于传统洁净室工艺的情况下，保持脆弱层状材料的优异量子特性。
AI.motivation: 二维材料和范德华异质结构是构建量子器件的优越平台，但传统纳米加工工艺会直接处理活性材料，从而损害原子级薄晶体的本征性质。可转移电路虽然能解决这一问题，但此前的自下而上方法需要复杂的制备步骤和专门的工具设备，限制了其广泛应用。
AI.method: 作者提出了一种简化的自上而下策略来制备SiNx纳米膜电路，降低了制备复杂度、加工步骤和专用工具需求。作为材料保真度的严格基准测试，他们将四单胞厚的最优掺杂Bi2201超导薄片电学集成到该NMB电路中。
AI.result: 集成后的Bi2201薄片表现出Tc~32K的超导转变，接近母体晶体通过磁化率测得的Tc~34K，表明超导性得到了很好的保持。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了在不直接暴露于传统洁净室工艺的情况下，可以实现脆弱层状材料的电学集成，同时保持其超导等量子特性，为集成更复杂的范德华异质结构、莫尔材料和混合量子架构提供了通用平台。

title: Posterior Inference of Hamiltonian Parameters from RIXS Spectroscopy
summary: We present the first application of simulation-based inference to resonant inelastic X-ray scattering spectroscopy. Using truncated marginal neural ratio estimation to efficiently restrict the prior and conditional flow matching as the joint density estimator, we infer full posteriors with a modest simulation budget for two Ni$^{2+}$ compounds---NiPS$_3$ as a representative covalent case and K$_2$NiF$_4$ as a more atomic one. We demonstrate that a vision transformer encoder whose tokenization matches the physical layout of the RIXS map yields better-covered and sharper posteriors than generic image encoders. Applying the validated method to experimental NiPS$_3$ and K$_2$NiF$_4$ data, we recover a joint posterior that reveals parameter correlations invisible to point estimators, and a posterior predictive distribution that closely matches the observed spectrum. The amortized posterior unlocks a class of analyses not previously available to the field such as nuisance-marginalized uncertainty quantification, multi-measurement posterior fusion and active experimental design.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将基于仿真的推断(SBI)应用于共振非弹性X射线散射(RIXS)光谱分析。通过截断边际神经比率估计和条件流匹配作为联合密度估计器，在适中的仿真预算下推断出两种Ni²⁺化合物(NiPS₃和K₂NiF₄)的完整后验分布。物理布局匹配的视觉Transformer编码器比通用图像编码器产生覆盖更好、更尖锐的后验。该方法能揭示点估计器看不见的参数相关性，且摊销后验支持不确定性量化、多测量后验融合和主动实验设计等新分析。
AI.motivation: RIXS光谱分析传统上依赖点估计器等难以准确处理多维参数空间的方法，无法捕获参数间的相关性和完整的不确定性。作者旨在引入仿真推断框架，实现对RIXS数据的完整贝叶斯后验推断，从而挖掘更多物理信息。
AI.method: 采用截断边际神经比率估计(TMNR)高效约束先验，条件流匹配(CFM)作为联合密度估计器。使用视觉Transformer编码器，其token化方式与RIXS图的物理布局相匹配，以生成更优的后验分布。整个流水线在适中的仿真预算下完成对两种Ni²⁺化合物的后验推断。
AI.result: 物理布局感知的视觉Transformer编码器在后验覆盖率与尖锐度上优于通用图像编码器。在实验NiPS₃和K₂NiF₄数据上恢复出揭示参数相关性的联合后验，后验预测分布与观测光谱高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: 摊销后的后验为RIXS领域开启了全新分析可能性，包括干扰因子边际化的不确定性量化、多测量后验融合以及主动实验设计，标志着SBI在凝聚态光谱学中的首次成功应用。

title: Disorder signatures emerging at millikelvin temperatures in Si/SiGe field-effect stacks
comment: 15 pages (6 main, 9 supplementary), 13 figures (3 main, 10 supplementary)
summary: The performance and scalability of electron spin qubits based on gate-defined quantum-dots in undoped Si/SiGe field-effect stacks remain constrained by disorder originating from the gate stack. Its coupling to the quantum well can be reduced by increasing the Si quantum well depth, while electrostatic charge history, for example through interface-trap filling, can further modify the effective disorder landscape. Although such disorder is commonly benchmarked through mobility measurements using magnetotransport and Hall bar devices, dedicated investigations at millikelvin temperatures relevant for quantum-dot operation remain limited. Here, we use temperature-dependent magnetotransport on Hall bar shaped field-effect transistors to investigate how mobility-based disorder signatures depend on quantum-well depth and charge history from \(1.5~\mathrm{K}\) down to the millikelvin regime. We show that magnetotransport characterization at \(1.5~\mathrm{K}\) captures the dominant mobility improvement associated with reduced dielectric-interface coupling, but can underestimate disorder differences that emerge at millikelvin temperatures, particularly in the low-density regime. Our results therefore highlight that millikelvin magnetotransport characterization of Hall bar devices can provide additional insight for optimizing Si/SiGe field-effect stacks, particularly in the context of gate-defined quantum dot spin qubits.

AI.tldr: 本文通过温度依赖的磁输运测量，研究了Si/SiGe场效应晶体管中量子阱深度和电荷历史对无序特征的影响，发现1.5K下的磁输运表征能捕获主要的迁移率改善，但在毫开尔文低温特别是低密度区域会低估无序差异，因此毫开尔文磁输运表征可为优化量子点自旋量子比特堆栈提供额外见解。
AI.motivation: 基于栅极定义量子点的电子自旋量子比特在未掺杂Si/SiGe场效应堆栈中的性能和可扩展性受到栅极堆栈引入的无序的限制。虽然无序通常通过霍尔器件迁移率测量来评估，但针对量子点工作相关的毫开尔文温度的专门研究仍然有限。
AI.method: 在霍尔棒形状的场效应晶体管上进行温度依赖的磁输运测量（从1.5K到毫开尔文温区），系统研究基于迁移率的无序特征如何依赖于量子阱深度和电荷历史（如界面陷阱填充）。
AI.result: 1.5K下的磁输运表征能够捕获与降低介电界面耦合相关的主要迁移率改善，但在毫开尔文温度下（特别是低密度区域）会低估无序差异。
AI.conclusion: 毫开尔文温度下的霍尔器件磁输运表征可以为优化Si/SiGe场效应堆栈提供额外的见解，特别是在栅极定义量子点自旋量子比特的应用背景下。

title: Accurate and efficient calculation of atomic forces in solids with non-self-consistent hybrid functionals
summary: Hybrid functionals are routinely employed self-consistently within the generalized Kohn-Sham framework. The evaluation of the nonlocal Fock exchange operator makes hybrid functional calculations computationally expensive, in particular with plane-wave basis sets. Here, we investigate the advantages of non-self-consistent hybrid functional calculations, focusing on the evaluation of atomic forces. The analytical force terms that arise due to non-self-consistency are computed using density functional perturbation theory (DFPT), as implemented within the Quantum ESPRESSO distribution. A non-self-consistent hybrid force calculation thus consists of self-consistent DFPT calculations with a local or semi-local functional and a single evaluation of the Fock exchange operator. The overall computational cost is, thereby, reduced in general, especially for solids that require a dense Brillouin-zone sampling. Moreover, results for structural parameters are barely affected by self-consistency, and vibrational frequencies are typically agreeing within 0.5%, thus making non-self-consistent calculations an interesting alternative.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了非自洽混合泛函计算在原子力评估中的优势，通过密度泛函微扰理论计算非自洽带来的解析力项，在Quantum ESPRESSO中实现。该方法仅需局域或半局域泛函的自洽DFPT计算加一次Fock交换算符评估，整体计算成本更低，结构参数几乎不受影响，振动频率误差在0.5%以内。
AI.motivation: 混合泛函（如杂化泛函）在广义Kohn-Sham框架中被广泛使用，但非局域Fock交换算符的评估使得计算代价高昂，尤其在平面波基组下。作者希望探索非自洽混合泛函计算的可行性，以降低计算成本。
AI.method: 采用非自洽混合泛函计算方法，利用密度泛函微扰理论（DFPT）计算非自洽性引入的解析力修正项，在Quantum ESPRESSO软件中实现。计算流程为：使用局域或半局域泛函进行自洽DFPT计算，再加上一次Fock交换算符的求值。
AI.result: 该方法在总体上降低了计算成本，尤其对于需要密集布里渊区取样的固体体系效果显著。结构参数结果几乎不受自洽性影响，振动频率与自洽结果的一致性在0.5%以内。
AI.conclusion: 非自洽混合泛函计算是一种有吸引力的替代方案，能够在保持精度的同时显著降低计算开销，特别是在处理需要密集k点采样的固体材料时。

title: SPEAR: Structure Property Explainability with Attention Regularization
summary: Machine learning is increasingly used to learn structure property relationships from spectroscopic and diffraction data, yet its adoption in materials discovery is often limited by poor interpretability of model predictions. Although attention mechanisms are frequently treated as inherently explainable, unregularized attention can yield unstable, fragmented, or intensity driven attribution patterns that obscure the physical origin of these relationships. Here we introduce SPEAR (Structure Property Explainability with Attention Regularization), a framework that constrains attention distributions during training to improve their stability, selectivity, and physical interpretability. SPEAR augments attention based regression with a learnable temperature that controls attention concentration and a smoothness penalty that enforces coherence across neighboring spectral positions, treating attention as a learnable explanatory object rather than a post hoc visualization. Using synthetic spectral benchmarks with known generative structure, we show that attention regularization produces smooth, contiguous attribution profiles aligned with causal features while preserving predictive accuracy. Applied to experimental X ray diffraction data from a combinatorial rare earth zirconate thin film library, the regularized model selectively emphasizes physically relevant diffraction features and decouples feature importance from raw peak intensity. The reflection it identified prompted a reassessment of our earlier structural analysis, revealing a correlation between the 220 peak position, the tetragonal distortion that accommodates cation size disorder, and the local thermal conductivity. Attention regularization therefore provides a principled training constraint for explainable structure property regression, yielding mechanistically meaningful explanations without sacrificing predictive performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPEAR框架，通过在训练过程中约束注意力分布（可学习温度控制注意力集中度+平滑性惩罚保证相邻谱位置连贯性），提升注意力机制在光谱/衍射数据中的稳定性、选择性和物理可解释性，在合成基准和实验XRD数据上均验证了其能产生与因果特征对齐的平滑注意力图谱，同时保持预测精度。
AI.motivation: 机器学习在材料发现中的应用受限于模型预测的可解释性差。注意力机制虽常被视为可解释的，但未正则化的注意力会产生不稳定、碎片化或强度驱动的归因模式，难以揭示物理起源。
AI.method: SPEAR框架包括：(1) 在基于注意力的回归中引入可学习温度参数控制注意力集中度；(2) 添加平滑性惩罚项强制相邻谱位置的注意力连贯性；(3) 将注意力视为可学习的解释对象而非事后可视化工具。
AI.result: 在合成光谱基准上，注意力正则化产生与因果特征对齐的平滑连续归因图谱且保持预测精度；在实验稀土锆酸盐薄膜XRD数据上，模型选择性强调物理相关衍射特征，将特征重要性从原始峰强度中解耦，识别出的220峰与四方畸变和局域热导率的关联促使重新评估了先前的结构分析。
AI.conclusion: 注意力正则化为可解释的结构-性质回归提供了原则性的训练约束，能产生具有机理意义的解释而不牺牲预测性能。

title: Quantum Geometric Kondo Cloud
summary: A magnetic impurity embedded in a metal is collectively screened by Fermi-surface quasiparticles into a many-body spin-singlet ground state, forming a Kondo cloud of size $ξ_{\rm K}\sim\hbar v_F/(k_B T_{\rm K})$. This kinematic picture collapses in flat bands, where $v_F=0$ and the hierarchy of dispersive energy shells is absent. Here we show that the missing organizing principle is quantum geometry. A magnetic impurity coupled to an isolated flat band selects a single active bath mode: a coherent superposition of flat-band Bloch states weighted by the hybridization factor $v(\mathbf{k})$, while all orthogonal flat-band modes remain dark. The resulting flat-band Kondo problem is a quantum geometric molecule, with an algebraic Kondo scale set by the total projected hybridization strength rather than a logarithmic-renormalization scale. In real space, the impurity-bath spin correlation defines a quantum geometric Kondo cloud. Its cloud-size tensor admits a gauge-invariant decomposition into a hybridization-weighted quantum metric, a dressed Berry-connection covariance, and a positive hybridization-gradient term, yielding the lower bound $ξ_{\rm K}^2\geq \sum_{\mathbf{k}}ρ(\mathbf{k}){\rm Tr}\,g(\mathbf{k})$, where $ρ(\mathbf{k})=|v(\mathbf{k})|^2/\sum_{\mathbf{k}}|v(\mathbf{k})|^2$. Our result reveals that, in flat bands, Kondo screening is governed by the quantum geometry and interference structure of the impurity-selected Bloch wave packet, rather than Fermi-surface kinematics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究平带中磁性杂质的Kondo屏蔽问题。在传统金属中，Kondo云由费米面准粒子的运动学（费米速度$v_F$）决定，但在平带中$v_F=0$，该图像失效。作者发现平带Kondo问题由量子几何（量子度规和Berry联络）主导：杂质只选择单个活跃的平带能隙模式，形成"量子几何Kondo云"，其尺度张量可分解为杂化权重量子度规、Berry联络协方差和正定的杂化梯度项，并给出下界$\xi_K^2 \geq \sum_{\mathbf{k}}\rho(\mathbf{k})\mathrm{Tr}\,g(\mathbf{k})$。
AI.motivation: 传统Kondo物理建立在费米面准粒子的运动学图像上，Kondo云尺寸$\xi_K \sim \hbar v_F/(k_B T_K)$依赖于费米速度。但在平带系统中$v_F=0$，这一图像完全失效，且缺乏解释平带Kondo屏蔽的组织原理。作者旨在找到平带中替代费米面运动学的核心机制。
AI.method: 作者证明：磁性杂质耦合到孤立平带时，仅选择一个活跃的带模式——由杂化因子$v(\mathbf{k})$加权的平带Bloch态的相干叠加，其余正交平带模式保持"暗态"。由此将平带Kondo问题映射为"量子几何分子"。在实空间中，杂质-浴自旋关联定义量子几何Kondo云，其尺度张量通过规范不变的分解表达：杂化加权的量子度规、 dressed Berry联络协方差和正定的杂化梯度项。
AI.result: 得到关键不等式$\xi_K^2 \geq \sum_{\mathbf{k}}\rho(\mathbf{k})\mathrm{Tr}\,g(\mathbf{k})$，其中$\rho(\mathbf{k})$为归一化杂化权重。这建立了Kondo云尺寸与量子度规张量的直接联系，表明Kondo尺度由总投影杂化强度（代数型）决定，而非对数重整化尺度。
AI.conclusion: 在平带中，Kondo屏蔽由杂质选择的Bloch波包的量子几何和干涉结构支配，而非费米面运动学。这一发现揭示了量子几何作为平带关联现象的新组织原理，拓展了Kondo物理的适用范围。

title: Anomalous Orbital Reconstruction Controlled by Interorbital Correlations and Hund's Coupling
summary: The microscopic origin of anomalous orbital polarization in a class of low-dimensional correlated oxides remains unresolved due to the competition among crystal-field effects, electronic correlations, and orbital-dependent dimensionality. Using dynamical mean-field theory, we investigate a two orbital Hubbard model with orbital-dependent dimensionality and reveal the mechanism for anomalous orbital polarization through orbital reconstruction beyond the bare crystal-field picture. We identify interorbital Coulomb interaction-induced charge competition as a key microscopic mechanism responsible for the orbital redistribution, which leads first to an orbital-polarized correlated metal and subsequently to an orbital-polarized Mott insulator. We further find that Hund's coupling acts as a filling-dependent regulator of orbital reconstruction. It weakens the correlation-induced orbital redistribution at quarter filling by competing with interorbital charge fluctuations, while at half filling it completely suppresses the orbital-polarized state by stabilizing high-spin orbital-balanced configurations. These results provide a unified picture of correlation driven orbital reconstruction and highlight the relevance of interorbital interactions and Hund's coupling for understanding orbital phenomena in low-dimensional transition-metal oxides.

AI.tldr: 本文利用动力学平均场理论研究了具有轨道依赖维度的双轨道Hubbard模型，揭示了低维关联氧化物中反常轨道极化的微观机制——轨道重构超越了裸晶体场图像，其中层间库仑相互作用诱导的电荷竞争是关键机制，而Hund耦合则作为填充依赖的调节器控制轨道重构。
AI.motivation: 低维关联氧化物中反常轨道极化的微观起源一直未解，原因在于晶体场效应、电子关联和轨道依赖维度之间的竞争关系尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用动力学平均场理论（DMFT），研究一个具有轨道依赖维度的双轨道Hubbard模型，分析晶格场与关联效应的竞争如何塑造轨道极化行为。
AI.result: 发现层间库仑相互作用诱导的电荷竞争是轨道重构的关键微观机制，导致系统先演化为轨道极化的关联金属，再进入轨道极化的Mott绝缘体。Hund耦合在四分之一填充时通过竞争层间电荷涨落削弱关联诱导的轨道重构，而在半填充时通过稳定高自旋轨道平衡构型完全抑制轨道极化态。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了关联驱动轨道重构的统一图像，强调了层间相互作用和Hund耦合对于理解低维过渡金属氧化物中轨道现象的重要性。

title: Floquet Superlattices and Edge States in Graphene Nanoribbons
summary: Structured light provides a route to imprint spatially patterned Floquet potentials onto quantum materials. As a particular example, we study a zigzag graphene nanoribbon driven by two coherent tilted beams, whose interference creates a periodic polarization pattern that gives rise to a photo-induced superlattice. The matching between the periodicity of the optical field and the nanoribbon width leads to two regimes in the quasienergy spectrum: matched profiles preserve degenerate edge branches, while mismatched profiles yield a boundary-induced gap that survives in wide ribbons. We propose a two-edge model that captures this splitting through residual hybridization and the boundary-sampled optical field. The quasienergy gap reverses between valleys, leading to a valley-selective boundary response. Our results establish light-induced superlattices as a flexible method for valley selectivity in finite-size Dirac-like materials through tunable edge-state quasienergy splitting.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了由两束相干倾斜光束干涉产生的周期性极化图案对锯齿形石墨烯纳米带的驱动效应，发现光诱导超晶格与纳米带宽度匹配与否会导致准能谱中边缘态的不同行为，并提出了一个双边缘模型来解释边缘态劈裂，实现谷选择性边界响应。
AI.motivation: 结构化光为量子材料提供了一种空间图案化的周期性Floquet势的途径，但此前对光诱导超晶格在有限尺寸Dirac材料（如石墨烯纳米带）中如何影响边缘态和谷自由度缺乏系统理解。作者旨在探索光场周期性与纳米带尺寸匹配关系如何调控准能谱及谷选择性。
AI.method: 以两束相干倾斜光束干涉产生的周期性极化图案驱动锯齿形石墨烯纳米带，形成光诱导超晶格。通过分析光场周期与纳米带宽度的匹配/失配两种情况下的准能谱，提出双边缘模型以残差杂化和边界采样的光场来捕捉边缘态劈裂机制。
AI.result: 匹配的光谱剖面保持简并边缘分支，而失配的剖面在宽纳米带中也会产生边界诱导的能隙。准能隙在两个谷之间反转，导致谷选择性边界响应。
AI.conclusion: 光诱导超晶格可作为有限尺寸Dirac类材料中实现谷选择性的灵活方法，通过可调的边缘态准能劈裂来实现控制。该工作开辟了利用结构化光在纳米尺度调控拓扑边缘态和谷自由度的新途径。

title: Small-world structure of quantum computer hardware
summary: We show that the network of quantum register states of a quantum computer (QC), coupled through residual two-body interactions between qubits, exhibits small-world properties analogous to those of complex networks found in human society. The most probable Erdős number between any two states is about 9, comparable to the six degrees of separation reported by Milgram for social networks. Using the $\mathring{A}$berg criterion, which retains only interactions exceeding the local energy spacing, we construct an effective ($\mathring{A}$berg) network and show that, above a critical coupling strength, this network percolates into a giant component spanning nearly the whole quantum register space. This percolation transition closely matches the onset of quantum chaos and dynamical thermalization established previously via costly exact diagonalization, while our approach extends the accessible system size up to $n_q=30$ qubits.

AI.tldr: 本文发现量子计算机的量子寄存器态网络通过残余两体相互作用表现出小世界特性，其最可能的Erdős数约为9，与人类社会六度分离现象相当。利用Åberg准则构建有效网络，发现在临界耦合强度以上网络会渗透形成跨越整个量子寄存器空间的巨大连通分量，该渗透转变与量子混沌和动态热化的出现密切相关，且该方法可扩展至30个量子比特。
AI.motivation: 传统上研究量子混沌和动态热化需要昂贵的精确对角化计算，限制了可处理的系统规模。作者希望利用网络科学的方法，通过构建量子寄存器态之间的相互作用网络，以更高效的方式研究量子混沌和热化现象的涌现条件。
AI.method: 将量子计算机的量子寄存器态视为网络节点，以残余两体相互作用为连边构建网络；采用Åberg准则过滤掉低于局部能级间距的弱相互作用，构建有效网络；通过网络渗透分析研究临界耦合强度下的连通性转变。
AI.result: 量子寄存器态网络展现出小世界特性，最可能的Erdős数为9；在临界耦合强度以上，Åberg网络渗透形成跨越几乎整个寄存器空间的巨大连通分量；该渗透转变与之前通过精确对角化确定的量子混沌和动态热化起始点高度吻合，且可扩展至30个量子比特。
AI.conclusion: 网络渗透方法为研究量子混沌和热化提供了比精确对角化更高效的替代方案，将可处理系统规模显著扩展至30个量子比特，同时揭示了量子寄存器空间与复杂社会网络之间的结构相似性。

title: Electrostatic Phenomenology Benchmarks for Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials in Electrochemistry: Beyond the Energy-Force Metric
summary: Accurate treatment of long-range interactions in machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) is essential for electrochemical simulations. However, aggregate energy and force errors alone are insufficient to establish an MLIP's physical accuracy since they do not detect qualitative inconsistencies in the model such as the prediction of image-charge attraction, dielectric screening, or charge transfer. We introduce a benchmark suite EPhEct (Electrostatic Phenomena for Electrochemistry) of focused test cases designed to evaluate MLIPs on electrochemically relevant physical phenomena. The tests probe for image-charge attraction at a metal electrode, the splitting between longitudinal and transverse optical phonons as a probe of ionic and electronic screening, the dipole moment of interfacial water, and Fermi-level pinning during ion discharge. These tests establish a qualitative diagnostic routine complementary to aggregate energy-force metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了EPhEct基准测试套件，用于评估机器学习原子间势能（MLIPs）在电化学相关物理现象上的定性准确性，弥补了传统聚合能量-力误差指标无法检测模型物理不一致性的不足。
AI.motivation: 传统MLIP评估仅依赖聚合能量和力的误差指标，无法检测模型中的定性物理错误，如像电荷吸引、介电屏蔽或电荷转移的预测不准确，而这些对电化学模拟至关重要。
AI.method: 提出了EPhEct基准测试套件，包含四类聚焦测试用例：（1）金属电极处的像电荷吸引；（2）纵光学与横光学声子分裂（探测离子和电子屏蔽）；（3）界面水的偶极矩；（4）离子放电过程中的费米能级钉扎。
AI.result: 建立了针对电化学相关物理现象的定性诊断例程，作为聚合能量-力指标的补充。
AI.conclusion: EPhEct提供了一种系统性的定性评估方法，能够揭示MLIPs在电化学模拟中的物理不一致性，是对传统定量误差指标的重要补充。

title: Reaction-Transformation-Aware Flow Matching for Generalizable Transition State Generation
summary: Transition-state (TS) structures define the energetic barriers and mechanistic pathways of elementary chemical reactions, yet their identification remains computationally demanding because conventional saddle-point searches require expensive quantum-mechanical calculations. Recent machine-learning approaches have accelerated TS generation by predicting structures from reaction endpoint information, but they primarily learn geometric correspondence between endpoints and TSs, leaving the structural transformations underlying elementary reactions implicitly represented. To address this limitation, we introduce TransTS, a reaction-transformation-aware framework for generalizable TS generation from atom-mapped reactant-product pairs. TransTS explicitly learns atom-level structural transformations between reaction endpoints and integrates them with a unified atom-aligned geometric representation of reactants, TSs and products, enabling reaction-aware equivariant generation of TS geometries. TransTS is designed to provide reliable TS initial guesses for subsequent quantum-chemical refinement, where generated structures are evaluated not only by geometric similarity but also by their ability to converge to validated saddle points and recover the intended reaction pathways. Across IID and zero-shot OOD benchmarks, TransTS demonstrates improved TS initialization quality, with particularly strong generalization to unseen reaction distributions. On the challenging GDB-10-rxn and GDB-17-rxn OOD benchmarks, TransTS generates TS candidates that more frequently converge to validated saddle points and recover the intended elementary reactions after refinement than existing approaches under the same training regime. Scaling reaction coverage and model capacity further improves both geometric fidelity and refinement outcomes.

AI.tldr: 提出了TransTS框架，通过显式学习反应物与产物之间的原子级结构变换，并结合统一的原子对齐几何表示，实现反应感知的等变过渡态几何生成。在IID和零样本OOD基准上均优于现有方法，尤其在GDB-10-rxn和GDB-17-rxn OOD基准上生成的过渡态候选更频繁地收敛到验证的鞍点并恢复预期的基元反应路径。
AI.motivation: 传统过渡态搜索依赖昂贵的量子化学计算，而现有机器学习方法主要学习反应端点之间的几何对应关系，将基元反应背后的结构变换隐式表示，未充分挖掘结构变换信息，导致泛化能力受限。
AI.method: TransTS分三步：1）显式学习反应物与产物之间原子级结构变换；2）将这些变换与统一的原子对齐几何表示（包含反应物、过渡态和产物）整合；3）利用反应感知的等变生成网络生成过渡态几何构型。生成的结构作为后续量子化学精修的初始猜测。
AI.result: 在IID和零样本OOD基准上，TransTS展示了改进的过渡态初始化质量，尤其在未见反应分布上泛化能力强。在GDB-10-rxn和GDB-17-rxn OOD基准上，TransTS生成的过渡态候选比现有方法更频繁地收敛到验证鞍点并恢复预期基元反应。扩大反应覆盖范围和模型容量可进一步提升几何保真度和精修效果。
AI.conclusion: TransTS通过显式建模原子级结构变换并结合等变生成，实现了更通用、更准确的过渡态结构生成，特别在分布外泛化方面表现突出，为量子化学精修提供了更可靠的初始猜测，有望加速基元反应机理的自动化发现。

title: Realizing record-high transverse thermoelectric figure of merit at room temperature in artificially tilted multilayers based on high power factor NiFe alloy
summary: Transverse thermoelectric conversion using artificially tilted multilayers (ATMLs) offers a versatile device architecture that circumvents the structural limitations of conventional longitudinal thermoelectrics. However, achieving competitive room-temperature thermoelectric performance without an external magnetic field remains a critical challenge. Here, we report a record-high transverse thermoelectric figure of merit $z_{yx}T$ of 0.36 in Ni$_{50}$Fe$_{50}$/Bi$_{0.2}$Sb$_{1.8}$Te$_{3}$-based ATML at room temperature without an external magnetic field. Leveraging the longitudinal high power factor in a Ni$_{50}$Fe$_{50}$ alloy and the sharp contrast in electrical and thermal transport properties between $n$-type Ni$_{50}$Fe$_{50}$ and $p$-type Bi$_{0.2}$Sb$_{1.8}$Te$_{3}$, we engineer an anisotropic structure that simultaneously exploits high electrical conductivity, large transverse thermopower, and low thermal conductivity to maximize $z_{yx}T$ in ATML. Through the direct measurements of these thermoelectric transport parameters, we obtained $z_{yx}T$ of 0.36 in Ni$_{50}$Fe$_{50}$/Bi$_{0.2}$Sb$_{1.8}$Te$_{3}$-based ATML, which is in excellent agreement with the analytical prediction of 0.36 owing to the low interfacial electrical and thermal resistances at the Ni$_{50}$Fe$_{50}$/Bi$_{0.2}$Sb$_{1.8}$Te$_{3}$ junctions. These results pave the way for the practical implementation of transverse thermoelectric materials around room temperature.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了基于Ni50Fe50/Bi0.2Sb1.8Te3人工倾斜多层膜（ATML）的横向热电转换，在室温无外加磁场条件下实现了创纪录的横向热电优值z_yxT = 0.36，通过巧妙设计各向异性结构同时实现了高电导率、大横向热电势和低热导率。
AI.motivation: 传统纵向热电材料存在结构局限性，而横向热电转换（ATML）虽能规避这一限制，但在无外磁场条件下实现具有竞争力的室温热电性能仍是关键挑战。
AI.method: 利用n型Ni50Fe50合金的高纵向功率因子与p型Bi0.2Sb1.8Te3之间电学和热输运性质的显著对比，工程化设计各向异性结构，同时优化高电导率、大横向热电势和低热导率以最大化z_yxT；并通过直接测量热电输运参数进行验证。
AI.result: 在室温无外磁场条件下，Ni50Fe50/Bi0.2Sb1.8Te3基ATML实现了z_yxT = 0.36的创纪录横向热电优值，与理论预测值0.36高度一致，这得益于界面处极低的电学和热学接触电阻。
AI.conclusion: 该成果为横向热电材料在室温附近的实际应用铺平了道路，证明了无需外磁场即可实现高竞争力横向热电性能的可行性。

title: Chiral spin liquid and chiral antiferromagnetism in half-filled moiré Hubbard model: possible applications to twisted bilayer TMDs
summary: Twisted transition metal dichalcogenides offer an exceptionally tunable moiré platform for studying correlation physics beyond conventional condensed matter systems. In particular, the intriguing interplay between the displacement field and the twist angle remains to be fully resolved. In this paper, we use large-scale density matrix renormalization group simulations to study the minimal moiré Hubbard model on a triangular lattice at half-filling, where the displacement field effect is captured by a spin-dependent staggered flux. We find that the displacement field significantly enriches the triangular Hubbard phase diagram in several qualitative ways. It rapidly destabilizes the chiral spin liquid phase beyond a narrow weak-field regime, induces pronounced chiral correlations in the strong-coupling $120^\circ$-antiferromagnetic phase, and stabilizes incommensurate spin-density wave phases at weaker coupling. We further find signatures of a continuous transition between the chiral spin liquid and chiral antiferromagnetic phases at a finite displacement field, potentially driven by spinon condensation. Our results uncover rich displacement-field-driven many-body physics and provide useful guidance for future experiments in moiré superlattice systems.

AI.tldr: 本文利用大规模密度矩阵重正化群模拟，研究了三角晶格上半填充的最小莫尔哈伯德模型，其中位移场效应由自旋依赖的阶梯通量表征。研究发现位移场显著丰富了三角哈伯德相图：迅速破坏窄弱场区间的手性自旋液体相，在强耦合120°反铁磁相中诱导显著手性关联，并在弱耦合下稳定非公度自旋密度波相。此外还发现有限位移场下手性自旋液体到手性反铁磁相之间存在连续相变的迹象，可能由自旋子凝聚驱动。
AI.motivation: 扭转过渡金属二硫化物提供了高度可调的莫尔平台，用于研究超越传统凝聚态体系的关联物理。特别是位移场与扭转角之间有趣的相互作用尚未得到完全解决，亟需深入理解。
AI.method: 采用大规模密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）模拟方法，对三角晶格半填充的最小莫尔哈伯德模型进行研究，其中位移场效应通过自旋依赖的阶梯通量加以刻画。
AI.result: 研究发现位移场以多种定性方式显著丰富了三角哈伯德相图：(1) 在窄弱场区间之外快速破坏手性自旋液体相；(2) 在强耦合120°反铁磁相中诱导显著的手性关联；(3) 在弱耦合下稳定非公度自旋密度波相。并发现有限位移场下存在手性自旋液体与手性反铁磁相之间连续相变的迹象。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了丰富的位移场驱动多体物理现象，为未来莫尔超晶格系统的实验提供了有价值的指导。

title: Periodicity-driven revision of the phase diagram of the generalized Baxter-Wu model with asymmetric complex couplings
summary: The conventional self-dual lines of the generalized Baxter-Wu (GBW) model with asymmetric complex couplings are known to be $\sinh(2K)=\pm \cos(2φ)$, where $K$ and $φ$ are the real and imaginary parts of the coupling. We demonstrate that these lines are incomplete: the periodicity of the partition function, encoded in the cosine factor of the bundled Boltzmann weight, generates additional self-dual lines $\sinh(2K)=\pm \sin(2φ)$. Guided by the complete set of self-dual candidates, we perform Monte Carlo simulations using brute-force reweighting (Metropolis) and the Wang-Landau methods. Simulations indicate that the self-dual lines at the partition-function minima $φ_{\mathcal{Z}_{\min}}=(2n+1)π/8$ constitute a critical threshold. They are genuine critical boundaries for $|K| \ge \frac{1}{2}\operatorname{arsinh}(\cos(π/4)) \approx 0.32924$, while for smaller $|K|$ they are not. At $φ_{\mathcal{Z}_{\min}}$, the sign problem is most severe and finite-size scaling corrections are largest; the local peak observed below the phase boundary in the temperature scan is thus a finite-size artifact, not a genuine new phase. We further clarify the capability and limitations of the average sign and its derivatives for detecting phase transitions. In particular, the negative peak of the average sign at $φ_{\mathcal{Z}_{\min}}$ does not correspond to a genuine phase transition. We also evaluate the Wang-Landau method, which, despite formally circumventing the sign problem, still faces the exponential barrier.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了广义Baxter-Wu模型在非对称复耦合下的常规自对偶线 sinh(2K)=±cos(2φ) 是不完整的，通过玻尔兹曼权重捆绑中余弦因子的周期性发现了新的自对偶线 sinh(2K)=±sin(2φ)。通过蒙特卡洛模拟（Metropolis重加权和王-朗道方法），揭示了在配分函数极小值 φ_Zmin=(2n+1)π/8 处的自对偶线构成临界阈值：对于 |K|≥0.32924 是真实临界边界，否则不是。文中还澄清了平均符号及其导数在检测相变中的能力与局限，并评估了王-朗道方法虽然形式上规避了符号问题，但仍面临指数级障碍。
AI.motivation: 纠正广义Baxter-Wu模型中自对偶线的不完整描述，该模型的复耦合导致符号问题，需要更准确地定位临界边界，并厘清符号问题与相变检测之间的关系。
AI.method: 理论上通过配分函数的周期性和玻尔兹曼权重捆绑的余弦因子推导出完整的自对偶线集合；数值上使用暴力重加权（Metropolis）和王-朗道两种蒙特卡洛方法进行模拟验证。
AI.result: 发现新的自对偶线 sinh(2K)=±sin(2φ)；在 φ_Zmin 处，自对偶线在 |K|≥0.32924 时是真实临界边界；配分函数极小值处符号问题最严重，有限尺寸修正最大，温度扫描中的局部峰是有限尺寸伪影；平均符号的负峰不对应真实相变；王-朗道方法虽形式规避符号问题但仍受指数障碍制约。
AI.conclusion: 广义Baxter-Wu模型具有更丰富的自对偶结构，完整自对偶线集合对正确识别临界行为至关重要；符号问题的严重程度与配分函数结构密切相关，且平均符号本身不足以可靠地指示真实相变，需结合多种判据进行判断。

title: Universal aspects of bulk density of states in non-Hermitian lattices
summary: Non-Hermitian lattice Hamiltonians generally exhibit strong boundary sensitivity, with periodic and open boundary conditions producing distinct density of states (DOS) in the complex-energy plane. This has led to the view that extended non-Hermitian systems lack a unique bulk DOS, with different prescriptions representing inequivalent bulk physics. Here, we show that this apparent ambiguity is largely illusory. For any finite-range tight-binding Hamiltonian, we establish a universal bulk structure: all DOS definitions arising as thermodynamic limits of finite systems share identical multipole moments and generate identical bulk dynamics at finite times and for observables measured far from boundaries. This universality is intimately tied to the thermodynamic Green's functions, which we show to be independent of the boundary condition for large enough complex frequencies. Among all equivalent descriptions, we identify the Brown measure - obtained via Hermitization and resolvent analysis - as a canonical and convenient representative of the bulk DOS, defined directly from the infinite-volume Hamiltonian. We further show that point-gap topology imposes additional universal constraints: boundary-dependent Green's functions are forced to coincide throughout topologically trivial point gaps. This, in particular, provides a systematic criterion, valid in arbitrary dimension, for determining where and how eigenvalues of different boundary truncations can accumulate in the complex plane, and precisely delineates the regime in which the DOS ambiguity retains physical significance.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了非厄米晶格哈密顿量的体密度态（bulk DOS）在不同边界条件下的表观歧义大多是虚幻的：所有有限系统热力学极限下的DOS定义共享相同的多极矩，并在有限时间和远离边界处产生相同的体动力学。作者识别出Brown测度作为体DOS的规范代表，并揭示点隙拓扑对格林函数施加额外普适约束。
AI.motivation: 非厄米晶格哈密顿量对边界条件极其敏感，周期边界与开放边界在复能量平面产生不同的态密度，导致学界认为扩展非厄米系统缺乏唯一的体DOS，不同定义代表不等价的体物理。作者旨在澄清这种表观歧义的本质。
AI.method: 作者对任意有限程紧束缚哈密顿量建立了普适体结构分析：通过热力学格林函数在复频率域中证明其与边界条件无关（当复频率充分大时），进而论证所有DOS定义共享多极矩；同时利用点隙拓扑对边界相关格林函数施加一致性约束，识别Brown测度（通过Hermitization和预解分析获得）作为无限体积哈密顿量直接定义的规范代表。
AI.result: 建立了非厄米系统的普适体结构：所有热力学极限下有限系统的DOS共享相同的多极矩并产生一致体动力学；热力学格林函数在大复频率下与边界条件无关；Brown测度是规范且方便的体DOS代表；点隙拓扑迫使边界相关格林函数在拓扑平凡点隙内完全重合，提供了任意维度下判定不同边界截断本征值在复平面何处及如何累积的系统判据。
AI.conclusion: 体DOS表观歧义在很大程度上是虚幻的，存在普适的体结构；Brown测度是规范代表；点隙拓扑在拓扑平凡区域消除了DOS歧义，并精确划定了DOS歧义仍具物理意义的范围，从而统一了非厄米系统体物理的描述框架。

title: Generalizing the multidimensional thermodynamic uncertainty relation to combinations of arbitrary counting variables
summary: Uncertainty relations provide lower bounds for otherwise hidden quantities of a partially accessible Markov network like the mean entropy production rate and the total dynamical activity. The thermodynamic uncertainty relation (TUR) is arguably the most prominent one and involves the precision of a fluctuating net current. One of its major generalizations is the multidimensional TUR (MTUR), which yields a tighter bound by using covariances of a set of observed net currents. We generalize this latter bound to time-dependently driven processes with arbitrary initial state and arbitrary measurement duration. Furthermore, this bound can be used with a set of fluctuating counting observables each of which can be time-antisymmetric, time-symmetric or time-asymmetric, i.e., a net current, a traffic or a flow. We can even allow for coarse-grained observations in which each counting observable could consist of multiple indiscernable observed transitions of the underlying system. Thus, we generalize the MTUR, extensions of the TUR for time-dependent processes based on one current, and an estimator based on one flux or on one traffic in a unifying way. We illustrate this general uncertainty relation with simple examples.

AI.tldr: 本文推广了多维热力学不确定性关系（MTUR），将其扩展到时间依赖驱动的马尔可夫过程，适用于任意初始状态和任意测量时长，并允许使用多种类型的计数可观测量（净电流、交通量、流量），还支持粗粒度观测。这是对TUR、MTUR及基于单一通量或交通量的估计器的统一推广。
AI.motivation: 热力学不确定性关系（TUR）是部分可观测马尔可夫网络中估计隐藏量（如平均熵产生率、总动态活性）下界的重要工具。多维TUR（MTUR）通过利用多个观测净电流的协方差提供更紧的界，但现有结果缺乏对时间依赖驱动过程、任意初始状态及更长测量时长的统一推广，且对不同类型的计数可观测量（对称/反对称/非对称）缺乏统一的处理框架。
AI.method: 作者将MTUR推广到时间依赖驱动的马尔可夫过程，支持任意初始状态和任意测量时长。该界可应用于三种类型的计数可观测量：时间反对称的净电流、时间对称的交通量以及时间非对称的流量。此外还允许粗粒度观测，即每个计数可观测量可由底层系统中多个不可区分的观测跃迁组成。通过统一的数学框架将已有的基于单一电流、单一路径或单一交通量的估计器推广合并。
AI.result: 作者得到了一种通用的不确定性关系，统一了MTUR、基于单一电流的时间依赖过程TUR扩展以及基于单一流量或交通量的估计器。该通用不确定性关系通过简单示例进行了验证和说明。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了一种更一般、更灵活的多维不确定性关系框架，适用于时间驱动系统，兼容多种观测类型和粗粒度场景，为熵产生率估计等隐藏量的下界求解提供了统一且更紧的工具。

title: Efficient simulation of second-order phase transitions in quantum anharmonic materials
summary: When a crystal undergoes a second-order structural phase transition, such as in ferroelectrics, Peierls, and charge-density waves, the diverging fluctuations of the order parameter lead to the break- down of the standard phonon quasiparticle picture. Simulating these highly anharmonic regimes is notoriously challenging, as methods such as molecular dynamics suffer from a critical slowdown near the transition point, while the harmonic approximation fails dramatically at saddle points of the energy landscape stabilized by quantum or thermal ionic fluctuations. This work introduces a new approach, based on the variational free-energy principle, to predict critical long-range behavior and dynamical spectra in strongly anharmonic systems, even when quantum ionic fluctuations dominate. The proposed framework builds upon the stochastic self- consistent harmonic approximation but reduces its computational scaling with the number of atoms, N, from O(N^6) to O(N^2) and the memory requirement from O(N^4) to O(N). We benchmark the method on the prototypical lead-free metal-halide perovskite CsSnI3, a promising candidate for photovoltaic engineering, simulating its phase stability and Raman spectrum near the phase transition, where the breakdown of the quasiparticle picture becomes evident. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the method by computing the full free-energy Hessian and the critical temperature in a supercell with 1080 atoms. Such simulations would have required tens of thousands of years with the legacy approach; it is now feasible in a few hours on consumer hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于变分自由能原理的新方法，用于预测强非谐系统中的临界长程行为和动力学谱，即使在量子离子涨落占主导时也有效。该方法基于随机自洽谐波近似，但计算复杂度从O(N^6)降至O(N^2)，内存需求从O(N^4)降至O(N)。在CsSnI3钙钛矿上验证了该方法，成功计算了1080原子超胞的自由能Hessian矩阵和临界温度。
AI.motivation: 二级结构相变（如铁电、Peierls和电荷密度波）中，序参量的发散涨落导致标准声子准粒子图像失效。现有方法面临两难：分子动力学在临界点附近存在临界减速，而谐波近似在鞍点处严重失败。需要一种能够在量子或热离子涨落稳定的强非谐区域中有效预测临界行为和动力学谱的方法。
AI.method: 基于变分自由能原理构建新框架，扩展了随机自洽谐波近似（SSCHA），将计算复杂度从O(N^6)降到O(N^2)（内存从O(N^4)降到O(N)），使其能够处理大规模超胞模拟。
AI.result: 在无铅金属卤化物钙钛矿CsSnI3上验证了方法的有效性，成功模拟了1080原子超胞的相稳定性、相变附近拉曼谱、自由能Hessian矩阵和临界温度。原本需要数万年计算的任务现在可在普通消费级硬件上数小时内完成。
AI.conclusion: 该新方法实现了对强非谐系统临界行为的实际可计算性，使过去不可行的超大尺寸模拟成为常规可行的计算任务，为理解和预测结构相变（特别是量子涨落主导的体系）提供了有力工具，对光伏材料等应用领域具有重要意义。

title: Poly(1,4-anthraquinone) as an Organic Cathode Material: Simulation of Observable Bonding Properties to Li, Na, Mg, and Ca
summary: Poly(1,4-anthraquinone) (P14AQ) has emerged as a promising cathode material, offering high capacity and good cycling stability, yet the atomic-scale mechanisms governing metal-ion binding and electrochemical behavior remain poorly understood. To address this, we investigate the binding mechanisms of Li, Na, Mg, and Ca to P14AQ using quantum mechanical methods, particularly DFT and DFTB. A key challenge lies in the material's structural complexity: multiple conformers of P14AQ are energetically similar but kinetically isolated due to significant energy barriers. To account for this, we develop an automated method to generate all unique P14AQ conformers for a periodic polymer chain without rotational duplicates through an orientation labeling scheme. For each conformer, we systematically place a metal atom adjacent to every oxygen site, enabling a complete exploration of binding configurations. We observe two structural motifs: a single metal-oxygen bond and coordination to two opposite oxygen atoms. While Li and Na exhibit continuous energy distributions, Mg and Ca show an energy gap between the two motifs, with a strong preference for the two-oxygen binding configuration. Galvanostatic measurements support these findings by showing lower gravimetric capacities for Ca and Mg than for Li and Na. For Na, the different numbers of metal-oxygen bonds are reflected in the two voltage plateaus observed experimentally. Overall, the combined computational and experimental results explain the higher capacity of monovalent ions in P14AQ: divalent ions cannot bind efficiently to a single oxygen site due to unfavorable energetics, and the conformational distribution of the polymer chain prevents optimal coordination.

AI.tldr: 本文通过DFT和DFTB量子力学方法系统研究了聚(1,4-蒽醌)(P14AQ)正极材料与Li、Na、Mg、Ca四种金属离子的结合机制，开发了自动化构象生成方法以避免旋转重复，发现单价离子(Li、Na)能量连续分布而二价离子(Mg、Ca)存在两个结构基序之间的能隙，并通过恒电流测量验证了单价离子容量更高的实验结果。
AI.motivation: P14AQ作为有前景的正极材料具有高容量和良好的循环稳定性，但其原子尺度上的金属离子结合机制和电化学行为尚不清楚，需要深入理解以优化材料性能。
AI.method: 采用DFT和DFTB量子力学方法研究金属离子与P14AQ的结合；开发自动化方法通过方向标记方案生成所有独特的周期性聚合物链P14AQ构象（避免旋转重复）；对每个构象系统地将金属原子放置在每个氧原子位点旁，全面探索结合构型。
AI.result: 观察到两种结构基序：单金属-氧键和与两个相对氧原子的配位。Li和Na呈现连续能量分布，而Mg和Ca在两种基序间存在能隙且强烈偏好双氧结合构型。恒电流测量显示Ca和Mg的容量低于Li和Na；Na的不同金属-氧键数量反映在实验观察到的两个电压平台上。
AI.conclusion: 计算与实验结果的结合解释了P14AQ中单价离子容量更高的原因：二价离子因能量不利无法有效结合到单一氧位点，且聚合物链的构象分布阻止了最佳配位。这为理解有机电极材料中多价离子存储机制提供了重要见解。

title: Autferroics-based true random number generators with enhanced performance
summary: Physical entropy-driven true random number generators are essential for emerging probabilistic computing paradigms, but conventional implementations based on magnetic tunneling junctions have reached their performance plateaus limited by inherent tradeoffs and weak tunability. Here, autferroics, a sister branch of multiferroics, is proposed to construct true random number generators. Benefiting from its unique energy landscape due to strong seesaw-type magnetoelectricity, the performance of true random number generation can be significantly enhanced in autferroic tunneling junctions, verified by passing standard statistical tests. Furthermore, autferroics-based random number generators can exhibit multi-field tunability and intrinsic multi-state randomness, opening an avenue for efficient hardware realization of the complex-number arithmetic and simulation of probability distributions of quantum mixed states within stochastic circuits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用autferroics（多铁材料的一个分支）构建真正的随机数生成器（TRNG），通过其独特的跷跷板型磁电耦合能量景观，显著提升磁隧道结中随机数生成的性能，并通过标准统计测试验证。该方案还展现出多场可调谐性和本征多态随机性，为随机电路中的复数运算和量子混合态概率分布模拟提供了高效硬件实现途径。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于磁隧道结（MTJ）的真随机数生成器由于其固有的性能权衡和较弱的可调谐性，已经达到了性能瓶颈，需要新的物理机制来突破限制。
AI.method: 利用autferroics（多铁材料的分支）的强跷跷板型磁电耦合所导致的独特能量景观，构建autferroic隧道结（ATJ），以此作为真随机数生成器的核心器件。
AI.result: 基于autferroics的随机数生成器性能得到显著提升，并通过了标准统计测试；同时展示了多场可调谐性和本征多态随机性。
AI.conclusion: Autferroics为实现高效的真随机数生成器提供了新途径，有望在随机电路（stochastic circuits）中实现复数运算和量子混合态概率分布模拟的硬件化，为概率计算范式开辟新方向。

title: Observation of in-plane anomalous Nernst effect
summary: The Nernst effect, which enables the conversion of a heat current into a transverse voltage under magnetic field or spin magnetization, holds significant promise for energy harvesting and thermal management in future electronics. However, the conventional Nernst effect is fundamentally constrained by the orthogonality requirement that the applied field or spontaneous magnetization must be perpendicular to the plane defined by the temperature gradient and the induced voltage. Here we report that symmetry-tailored ultrathin films of a prototypical ferromagnetic oxide exhibit anomalous Nernst effect arising from intrinsic coupling to spontaneous in-plane spin magnetization. Systematic magnetothermoelectric measurements under spherical rotations of the magnetic field reveal that a pronounced Nernst signal, comparable in magnitude to the out-of-plane response, emerges robustly associated with out-of-plane orbital magnetization. Our findings demonstrate that the anomalous Nernst effect is no longer limited by the orthogonality condition, opening new opportunities for more flexible designs of magnetothermoelectric materials and devices.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了在对称性设计的铁磁氧化物超薄膜中，观察到由面内自发自旋磁化内在耦合驱动的反常能斯特效应，打破了传统能斯特效应要求磁场或磁化垂直于温度梯度与感应电压构成平面的正交性限制。系统性的球面旋转磁场磁热电测量表明，与面外轨道磁化相关的显著能斯特信号可与面外响应相当，为磁热电材料与器件的灵活设计开辟了新途径。
AI.motivation: 传统能斯特效应受正交性条件根本性制约，即外加磁场或自发磁化必须垂直于由温度梯度和感应电压定义的平面，这严重限制了磁热电材料与器件设计的灵活性，因此需要探索突破此限制的新机制。
AI.method: 采用对称性裁剪的铁磁氧化物超薄膜，通过球面旋转磁场的系统磁热电测量，在三维空间中全方位考察磁场方向对能斯特信号的影响，并分析信号与面外轨道磁化的关联。
AI.result: 在磁场球面旋转下观察到显著的反常能斯特信号，其幅度可与面外响应相当，且该信号与面内自旋磁化和面外轨道磁化紧密相关，表明反常能斯特效应不再受正交性条件限制。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了反常能斯特效应可以突破正交性限制，为更灵活的磁热电材料与器件设计提供了新的机遇。

title: Skyrmion Fractional Chern Insulator: An Intrinsically Multiband Route to Fractionalization in Rhombohedral Graphene
summary: We propose an unconventional microscopic origin for the fractional quantum anomalous Hall (FQAH) effect in rhombohedral graphene moiré superlattices: skyrmion fractionalization. We view the state at filling $ν<1$ as a metal of skyrmion vacancies, charge $+e$ objects formed by removing layer-pseudospin skyrmions from the interaction-generated skyrmion lattice Chern insulator at $ν=1$. These vacancies are intrinsically multiband degrees of freedom, absent in single Chern band-projected studies. Building on a recently proposed ideal limit, we first develop an effective field theory showing that skyrmion vacancies can themselves fractionalize, thereby inducing charge fractionalization. Focusing on $ν=\frac{2}{3}$, we then construct explicit variational trial wavefunctions for the resulting skyrmion fractional Chern insulator and provide numerical evidence, together with general arguments, showing that this process is energetically favored. Our results establish a realistic route to the FQAH that does not rely on a partially filled Chern band, but instead arises from fractionalization of collective pseudospin textures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出菱方石墨烯莫尔超晶格中分数量子反常霍尔（FQAH）效应的一种非传统微观起源：skyrmion分数化。该机制将ν<1的状态视为skyrmion空穴金属，这些空穴本身可以分数化，从而诱导电荷分数化，为FQAH提供了一条不依赖部分填充Chern带的现实途径。
AI.motivation: 传统FQAH研究依赖于部分填充的Chern带（单带投影方法），但这种方法忽略了多带自由度和集体自旋纹理的作用。作者希望寻找一种不依赖部分填充Chern带的FQAH实现途径，并解释菱方石墨烯莫尔超晶格中观测到的FQAH现象。
AI.method: 作者首先将ν=1的状态视为相互作用产生的skyrmion晶格Chern绝缘体。通过移除层赝自旋skyrmion，形成带电荷+e的skyrmion空穴，从而描述ν<1的金属态。基于理想极限，作者发展了一个有效场论，证明skyrmion空穴可以发生分数化。随后针对ν=2/3构建显式变分试探波函数，用于描述skyrmion分数Chern绝缘体，并通过数值证据和一般性论证支持该过程在能量上是有利的。
AI.result: 作者提供了数值证据和一般性论证，表明skyrmion空穴分数化过程在能量上是有利的，从而建立了从skyrmion集体赝自旋纹理分数化出发实现FQAH的现实途径。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了FQAH的一条新途径：不依赖部分填充的Chern带，而是源于集体赝自旋纹理的分数化。这些skyrmion空穴本质上是多带自由度，超越了单Chern带投影研究的范畴，为理解菱方石墨烯莫尔超晶格中的FQAH提供了新视角。

title: Linear response across interaction regimes in two-dimensional ferromagnets
summary: Recent discoveries of two-dimensional (2D) ferromagnets have stimulated intense interest in understanding and controlling their spin transport properties. A central microscopic feature of these systems is that exchange-driven magnon--magnon interactions are strongly momentum dependent: low-momentum magnons interact weakly, while high-momentum ones can scatter strongly and exhibit collective hydrodynamic behavior. Understanding transport in such systems therefore requires a microscopic description capable of capturing ballistic and hydrodynamic regimes on equal footing. The natural framework is the quantum Boltzmann equation (QBE), whose solution is notoriously difficult because of the multidimensional collision integrals. Here, we develop a method based on an efficient representation of distribution functions as sums of Gaussians, which renders the collision integrals tractable. This approach enables accurate solution of the linearized QBE and computation of momentum- and frequency-resolved linear response in 2D ferromagnets across a broad range of temperatures and magnetic fields. In particular, we resolve a temperature-driven crossover from a ballistic regime dominated by weakly interacting low-momentum magnons to a collective hydrodynamic regime governed by strongly interacting high-momentum modes. Applying this method to monolayer CrCl$_3$, we obtain good agreement with recent nitrogen-vacancy-center dephasing experiments that reported anomalous magnetic noise consistent with magnon sound. More broadly, our work establishes a general framework for computing momentum- and frequency-resolved linear response in interacting 2D quantum systems describable within quantum Boltzmann kinetics.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种基于高斯函数和表示分布函数的高效方法，使量子玻尔兹曼方程（QBE）中的多维碰撞积分变得可处理，从而能够精确求解线性化QBE并计算二维铁磁体中动量分辨和频率分辨的线性响应。该方法揭示了从弹道输运到集体流体动力学输运的温度驱动交叉，并在单层CrCl₃中与氮-空位中心退相实验取得了良好一致。
AI.motivation: 二维铁磁体中的自旋输运性质至关重要，其交换驱动的磁振子-磁振子相互作用强烈依赖动量：低动量磁振子相互作用弱，高动量磁振子相互作用强并表现出集体流体动力学行为。需要在统一框架下同时描述弹道和流体动力学区域，而自然框架QBE因多维碰撞积分难以求解，构成了主要挑战。
AI.method: 提出一种基于将分布函数表示为高斯函数和的高效表示方法，使碰撞积分变得可处理。该方法能够精确求解线性化QBE，并计算二维铁磁体中动量分辨和频率分辨的线性响应，适用于广泛的温度和磁场范围。
AI.result: 解决了从弱相互作用低动量磁振子主导的弹道区到强相互作用高动量模控制的集体流体动力学区的温度驱动交叉。将方法应用于单层CrCl₃，与近期氮-空位中心退相实验报告的反常磁噪声（与磁振子声一致）取得了良好吻合。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作建立了计算相互作用二维量子系统（可用量子玻尔兹曼动力学描述）中动量分辨和频率分辨线性响应的通用框架，为理解和控制二维铁磁体的自旋输运提供了新工具。

title: GPU implementation of mixed quantum-classical Liouville molecular dynamics without momentum jump
summary: We implemented on GPU a mixed quantum-classical Liouville molecular dynamics simulation based on a momentum-jump-free theory. The trajectory spawning that was previously implemented on CPU for sampling enhancement was eliminated to avoid the overhead of thread divergence and dynamic memory allocation on the GPU. This achieved a speedup of an order of magnitude compared to the CPU computation with spawning, as well as a linear scaling with respect to the number of sampling trajectories.

AI.tldr: 本文在GPU上实现了基于无动量跳跃理论的混合量子-经典Liouville分子动力学模拟。为提升GPU性能，作者移除了原先在CPU上用于采样增强的轨迹繁衍（trajectory spawning）方法，以避免线程发散和动态内存分配的开销，最终实现了相比CPU计算一个数量级的加速，并达到与采样轨迹数量线性扩展的效果。
AI.motivation: 传统CPU上的混合量子-经典Liouville分子动力学模拟计算成本高，虽然轨迹繁衍技术能增强采样，但其带来的线程发散和动态内存分配开销在GPU架构上成为瓶颈，需要针对GPU重新设计算法以充分发挥并行计算能力。
AI.method: 作者在GPU上实现了基于无动量跳跃理论的混合量子-经典Liouville分子动力学模拟，关键改动是移除CPU版本的轨迹繁衍方法，避免GPU上的线程发散（thread divergence）和动态内存分配（dynamic memory allocation）开销，从而简化计算流程并提高并行效率。
AI.result: 与带有轨迹繁衍的CPU计算相比，GPU实现获得了约一个数量级的加速，并且计算时间与采样轨迹数量呈线性扩展关系。
AI.conclusion: 在GPU架构上重新审视算法设计，移除可能引入低效的采样增强技术（如轨迹繁衍），虽然可能影响采样效率，但可以显著提升整体计算速度，实现数量级的性能提升和良好的可扩展性。

title: Is the TDDFRT representation of a molecular electronic transition unique?
summary: In this article a piece of the reference time-dependent density-functional response theory (TDDFRT) representation of molecular electronic transitions is studied through the one-body reduced difference density matrix. A first derivation route for that object has been reported in the literature based on the substitution of TDDFRT-related objects into an exact functional expression. We show in the text that the functional providing the exact object is not unique, and we question whether substituting the same TDDFRT-related objects into the alternative functional expressions leads to acceptable candidates for the approximate TDDFRT one-body reduced difference density matrix, which would question the unequivocality of the TDDFRT representation of molecular electronic transitions. We first directly address the problem using a novel diagrammatic language, inspired by Dyck languages, and specifically designed for dealing with this kind of issue. In the last part of the article we question whether it is possible or not to recast the problem in a more general framework - the equations-of-motion framework. Through all the text, the case of time-dependent Hartree-Fock is compared with that of TDDFRT to highlight what makes them so different when those questions are at stake.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了含时密度泛函响应理论（TDDFRT）中分子电子跃迁的单体约化差分密度矩阵表示。作者发现用于推导该精确对象的泛函表达式并不唯一，并质疑将相同的TDDFRT相关对象代入替代泛函表达式能否得到可接受的近似结果。文章引入了一种受Dyck语言启发的新型图解语言来处理该问题，并探讨了能否将问题推广到运动方程框架中，同时与含时Hartree-Fock进行对比。
AI.motivation: 核心动机是质疑TDDFRT对分子电子跃迁表示的"唯一性"。已有文献通过将TDDFRT相关对象代入一个精确泛函表达式来推导单体约化差分密度矩阵，但作者发现这个精确泛函并非唯一，因此需要检验代入不同泛函表达式是否会产生不一致的结果，从而威胁TDDFRT表示的唯一性和可靠性。
AI.method: 作者首先开发了一种新颖的图解语言（受Dyck语言启发），专门用于处理这类问题，通过该语言直接分析替代泛函表达式代入TDDFRT相关对象后是否产生可接受的近似差分密度矩阵。随后，作者探讨了能否将整个问题重新表述在更一般的运动方程（equations-of-motion）框架下。全文贯穿性地将含时Hartree-Fock与TDDFRT进行对比，突出两者在面对这些问题时的根本差异。
AI.result: 文中指出精确泛函表达式并非唯一，并通过图解语言对替代泛函表达式进行了检验。文章揭示了TDDFRT在表示分子电子跃迁时可能存在的非唯一性问题，并通过与含时Hartree-Fock的对比展示了二者在该问题上的本质区别。问题的可重述性——即能否在运动方程框架下统一处理——也在文末被探讨。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为TDDFRT中单体约化差分密度矩阵的推导依赖于特定泛函表达式，而该表达式并非唯一，这可能导致TDDFRT对分子电子跃迁的表示缺乏绝对的 unequivocality（明确唯一性）。通过图解语言的分析和运动方程框架的探讨，文章系统性地审视了这一问题，提醒研究者在应用TDDFRT表示电子跃迁时需注意其潜在的非唯一性局限。
